Text: これは……

English.Text: What's this?

Text: 当宿からの　ささやかなプレゼントです

English.Text: "A gift from our humble establishment.

Text: よろしければ　コミュニケーションツールとして ご活用ください

English.Text: "Though it may not look like much, it should help you to break the ice with those you meet."

Text: クイーンズ・ブラッド？

English.Text: Queen's Blood?

Text: おはようございます

English.Text: Good morning, sir.

Text:
ご挨拶が遅くなりました
私はブロード　この宿のオーナーです

English.Text: I must apologize for not introducing myself to you earlier. I'm Broden, the owner of this inn.

Text: みなさんは　すでにお出かけですよ

English.Text: Your companions have all stepped out.

Text:
ああ　そうだ
バレットさんから伝言をあずかってます

English.Text: Oh, but "Barret" left a message he wanted me to pass along to you.

Text:
『寝ぼすけのソルジャーさんよ
　今日は１日　自由行動だ』

English.Text:
"You missed roll call, SOLDIER boy.
Luckily, you're on leave for the day.

Text: 『いまのうちに　装備の点検でもしておくんだな』

English.Text:
"Don't waste it though.
Get your equipment checked ASAP."

Text: ……とのことです

English.Text: Sound advice.

Text: まずは　武器屋へ行かれてみてはいかがでしょう？

English.Text: Perhaps a trip to the arms dealer is in order?

Text: そうだな

English.Text: Good idea.

Text:
それと　クラウドさん
『スキルブック』をお持ちですよね

English.Text: By the way, Cloud. Do you have any folios on you?

Text: ああ

English.Text: Yeah.

Text:
でしたら　ついでに
本屋にも寄られてはどうでしょう？

English.Text:
In that case, you might also want
to pay a visit to Maghnata Books.

Text: カームの本屋は　由緒ある魔導書店の第１号店

English.Text:
They have stores all over, but the first
official one was built here in Kalm.

Text: たしか　初回はサービスしてくれるはずです

English.Text: And their resident scholars are remarkably talented.

Text:
熟練の技能士が
お客様の新たな能力を引き出すように

English.Text: If you want to unlock the true potential of your folios, you should go see them.

Text: スキルブックを　カスタマイズしてくれますよ

English.Text: The first customization is always free.

Text: カームは素朴でいい街ですよ

English.Text: Kalm's a simple─but beautiful─town.

Text: ゆっくり観光なさってください

English.Text: Take your time─see the sights.

Text: 武器屋と本屋には行かれましたかな

English.Text: Get your folios and weapons inspected yet?

Text: 起きたか

English.Text: Finally.

Text: よほど　疲れていたようだな

English.Text: Rough day yesterday, huh?

Text: 俺を待っていたのか？

English.Text: You've been waiting for me?

Text: 感謝を伝えていなかったと思ってな

English.Text: I've been waiting for a chance to thank you properly.

Text: クラウドたちのおかげで　宝条から逃げられた

English.Text: Without your help, I'd still be in Hojo's clutches─trapped in that lab.

Text: なりゆきだ

English.Text: Was nothing.

Text: だとしても　恩はかならず返す

English.Text: Even so, I owe you a debt. And till it's paid...

Text: しばらくは　一緒に行く

English.Text: I'm going to accompany you.

Text: そうだ

English.Text: Oh, uh...

Text: 装備の点検に行くなら　私の装備品も頼む

English.Text:
If you're getting your equipment checked,
have them check mine while you're at it.

Text: わかった

English.Text: Sure thing.

Text: えらそうな新入りだな

English.Text: The rook's got a backbone.

Text: おはよう

English.Text: Morning.

Text: ああ

English.Text: Morning.

Text: みんな　街を見に行ったみたい

English.Text: Everyone's kinda off doin' their own thing.

Text: そうらしいな

English.Text: I noticed.

Text: あのタンク　思い出さない？

English.Text: Say, uh... This tank remind you of anything?

Text: あのタンク　思い出さない？

English.Text: "This tank remind you of anything?"

Text: 約束した場所だ

English.Text: The place I made that promise to you.

Text: ニブルヘイムの給水塔に似てるな

English.Text: The water tower in Nibelheim.

Text: ただの魔晄タンクだ

English.Text: Any other mako tank.

Text: ああ　約束した場所だ

English.Text: Yeah. The place I made that promise to you.

Text: あの時の服　お気に入りだった

English.Text:
You remember the dress I wore?
It was one of my favorites.

Text: ああ　水色みたいな　緑みたいな色の

English.Text: Uh... The light blue one? With a bit of green in there?

Text: うん

English.Text: Yeah.

Text: ニブルヘイムの給水塔に似てるな

English.Text: Looks kinda like the water tower in Nibelheim.

Text: うん

English.Text: Right?

Text:
思い出の場所なのに
今はもう　ないんだよね

English.Text: Weird to think how much it meant to me back then. When it was still there.

Text: ただの魔晄タンクだ

English.Text: Any other mako tank.

Text: そう……だね

English.Text: Sorry. Dumb question.

Text:
ミッドガルから魔晄を運んで
あのタンクに貯めておくんだ

English.Text:
Makes you think, though...
How the mako in it came all the way from Midgar.

Text: そうなんだ

English.Text: Yeah, it does...

Text: おだやかで　いい街だね

English.Text: This is such a quiet, peaceful town.

Text:
なんだか　のんびりしちゃうね
いいのかな……

English.Text: Feels a little weird to be taking it easy, though...

Text: おう　お早いお目覚めで

English.Text: Look who it is. You up already?

Text: 朝から飲んでるのか

English.Text: Drinkin' already?

Text: 酒じゃねえよ

English.Text: Hah! No sir.

Text: 祝杯は　セブンスヘブンを再建してからだ

English.Text: Not gonna have a drop till Seventh Heaven's back up and runnin'.

Text: 祝杯は　セブンスヘブンを再建してからだ

English.Text: "Not gonna have a drop till Seventh Heaven's back up and runnin'."

Text: その時は俺がおごろう

English.Text: First one's on me.

Text: うまい酒になりそうだな

English.Text: First one'll taste good.

Text: 当分おあずけだな

English.Text: No time soon then.

Text: その時は　俺がおごろう

English.Text: First one's on me, okay?

Text: そりゃ　うれしいねえ

English.Text: Now that's what I'm talkin' about!

Text: んじゃ　高い酒を仕入れとかないとな

English.Text: Gotta remember to order some top-shelf stuff in that case.

Text: うまい酒になりそうだな

English.Text: First one'll taste good.

Text:
おうよ　ハデな開店パーティーを開いて
ドンチャン騒ぎよ

English.Text: Damn straight! 'Specially 'cause I'll be havin' it with friends at a huge party!

Text: 当分　おあずけだな

English.Text: No time soon then.

Text: また　すぐにやれるさ

English.Text: Hmph, well... Sooner than you think.

Text:
長旅になりそうだ
準備は　しっかりしとけよ

English.Text:
Got a long road ahead of us.
Better make sure you're prepped for the journey.

Text: 土産はまだ買うなよ　荷物になるだけだ

English.Text:
Don't go buyin' any souvenirs, y'hear?
They'll just weigh us down.

Text: 装備の点検は　終わったのか

English.Text: I take it our equipment is in order?

Text: ここで　なにをしている

English.Text: What are you doing here anyway?

Text:
見張りだ
いつ神羅が来ても　おかしくはない

English.Text:
Standing watch.
One can never be too careful with Shinra.

Text: 神羅が来ても　おかしくはない

English.Text: "One can never be too careful with Shinra."

Text: さすが　頼りになるな

English.Text: I knew I could count on you.

Text: 助かるよ

English.Text: Thanks.

Text: 真面目だな

English.Text: Good boy.

Text: さすが　頼りになるな

English.Text: I knew I could count on you.

Text: ほめても　なにも出ないぞ

English.Text: Hmph. Flattery will get you nowhere.

Text: 助かるよ

English.Text: Thanks.

Text: 気にするな　私自身のためだ

English.Text: No need to thank me. I'm doing this for myself.

Text: 真面目だな

English.Text: Good boy.

Text:
誰もやらないからな
しかたなくやっている

English.Text: Someone has to be. Next time, it might even be you.

Text: 見張りは　まかせろ

English.Text: Leave this to me.

Text: いまのところ　異状はない

English.Text: Nothing to report so far.

Text: クラウド　おはよう

English.Text: Aha, finally decided to get up?

Text: ああ　なにをしてるんだ？

English.Text: Yeah. So, whatcha been doin'?

Text: クラウド　探してたの

English.Text: Why, waiting for you, of course.

Text: そうか

English.Text: You have?

Text: 本屋に用事？

English.Text: Got business with the bookstore?

Text: あのね　そのあと時間ある？

English.Text: If so, I won't keep you. But if you're free afterwards...

Text: 塔のうえ　行ってみない？

English.Text: Wanna climb the clock tower together?

Text: 塔のうえ　行ってみない？

English.Text: "Wanna climb the clock tower together?"

Text: ああ　行こう

English.Text: Sure. Let's.

Text: しかたないな

English.Text: ...If I have to.

Text: ヒマじゃない

English.Text: I'm busy.

Text: ああ　行こう

English.Text: Sure. Let's.

Text: ホント？　やった！

English.Text: For real!? Awesome!

Text: しかたないな

English.Text: ...If I have to.

Text: その言い方！

English.Text: You got a real way with words.

Text: でも　ま　いっか

English.Text: You're lucky I speak your language, mister.

Text: ヒマじゃない

English.Text: I'm busy.

Text: ええ　そんなあ～　お願い！

English.Text: But it'll only take a few minutes! Come on!

Text: わかった

English.Text: Fine.

Text: やった！

English.Text: Sweet!

Text:
それじゃあ
入場券　もらっておくから

English.Text: Since it was my idea, I'll go get the tickets.

Text: 塔の前で　集合

English.Text: I'll meet you in front of the tower, okay?

Text: それじゃあ　あとでね

English.Text: I'll catch up with you later, alright?

Text: 塔の前で集合　だよ

English.Text: Don't forget. In front of the tower.

Text:
いらっしゃいませ
魔導書店へ　ようこそ

English.Text: Hey there! Welcome to Maghnata Books.

Text:
お客さん
スキルブックをカスタマイズするのは初めて？

English.Text:
Oh!
I take it this is your first visit to one of our stores.

Text:
スキルブックを強化するには　持ち主に
それ相応の知識や経験　能力が必要なんだけど

English.Text: Well, customization can seem tricky to the uninitiated. It takes time and experience to get it right.

Text:
お客さんは大丈夫そうだね
早速　やってみようか

English.Text:
But I think you'll pick it up quick enough.
Let's give it a try.

Text: まあ　最初はこんなもんかな

English.Text: ...And that's about all we can do for now.

Text:
スキルブックは　仲間との絆が深まることで
さらに力を引き出すことができるよ

English.Text: But we haven't even skimmed the surface, believe you me. There's much more to this than meets the eye.

Text:
また　強化したくなったら
いつでも持ってきなよ

English.Text: May not seem like it yet, but you'll see.

Text: いらっしゃい

English.Text: Hey there.

Text: おっ　また来たね

English.Text: Oh, back for more?

Text: 今日は　どうします？

English.Text: What'll it be?

Text: いつでもどうぞ

English.Text: See you around.

Text: また寄ってね

English.Text: Have a good one.

Text: ありがとうございました

English.Text: Thanks for stoppin' by.

Text: いらっしゃい

English.Text: Welcome.

Text:
おっ　兄ちゃん
渋い武器持ってるね

English.Text:
Damn...
That is quite the weapon you got there, mister.

Text: 使い込まれた　いい色してやがる

English.Text: Seen plenty of action, by the look of it.

Text:
ただ　そいつのポテンシャルはまだまだだ
しっかり整備すれば　もっと強くなるぜ

English.Text: But saying that, it's still only a shadow of what it could be. With a little love, that baby'll sing.

Text: どうだい　手ほどきしようか？

English.Text: If you like, I could show you.

Text:
いいねえ　輝きが増したじゃねえか
武器もニッコリ笑ってやがる

English.Text:
See─what'd I tell you! That girl is singing.
And she's got the voice of an angel.

Text:
これからも　定期的に
カスタマイズしてやるんだな

English.Text: Just make sure you take proper care of her, alright?

Text:
せっかくだ
ウチの商品も見ていってくれよ

English.Text:
Oh, and while you're here,
check out what we got to offer.

Text: そんじゃ　武器は大切にな

English.Text: You take care of that weapon now!

Text: よお　兄ちゃん　調子はどうだ？

English.Text: Back again! What can I do ya for?

Text: いらっしゃい　ゆっくり見ていけよ

English.Text: Lemme know if something piques your interest.

Text: ウチはいい品　そろえてるぜ

English.Text: We got a great selection here, you know.

Text: ありがとよ

English.Text: 'Preciate it.

Text: また　いつでも来いよ

English.Text: Hope to see you again!

Text: そんじゃ　気をつけてな

English.Text: You be careful out there.

Text: すみません　まだ準備中なんです

English.Text: Excuse me, sir, but the tower's not open yet.

Text: しばらくあとで　お越しください

English.Text: I'm afraid you'll have to come back later.

Text:
準備中だって
クラウド　用事すませてきたら？

English.Text: They said it's not open yet. If you got anything else you need to do, now's the time.

Text: クラウド　こっちこっち！

English.Text: Cloud! Over here!

Text: それじゃ　行こっか

English.Text: Let's get started then, shall we?

Text: ミッドガル　こっちだったよね

English.Text: I think Midgar's thisaway.

Text: そのはずだ

English.Text: Should be, yeah.

Text: ここから見ると　小さいね

English.Text: Funny, isn't it? How small it looks.

Text: 距離があるからな

English.Text: It is far away.

Text: ねえ　ティファとなにかあった？

English.Text: So...did something happen between you and Tifa?

Text: ほら　部屋　同じだったから

English.Text: Don't look so shocked. We're roommates, you know.

Text: なにか言ってたか

English.Text: She say something?

Text: 特には　なにも

English.Text: Not about you two, no.

Text: でも　わかる

English.Text: Still, I can tell.

Text: 幼なじみなんて　うらやましい

English.Text:
I would've given anything to have a friend
when I was growing up.

Text: 大切にしなくちゃ

English.Text: Don't take her for granted.

Text: ちきしょう

English.Text: Just what we need...

Text: 行け！

English.Text: Go!

Text:
Ａ班　Ｂ班わかれろ
アバランチを探せ！

English.Text:
A team, B team, you know the drill!
Let's find these terrorists!

Text: 行くぞ！

English.Text: Move!

Text: わたしたち　探してる？

English.Text: They're looking for us, aren't they?

Text: おそらく

English.Text: Gotta be.

Text: ああ　いたか

English.Text: Ah, there you are.

Text: 話はあと　とにかく宿に戻れ

English.Text:
There isn't much time.
We need to get back to the inn.

Text: でも……

English.Text: But...

Text: 仲間は避難した　あとは君たちだけだ

English.Text:
Don't worry about your friends.
They're safe; trust me.

Text:
戦おうなんて　考えないでくれ
街が巻き込まれる

English.Text: No violence─please. This town's suffered enough.

Text: 逃げよう

English.Text: C'mon.

Text: ついてこい

English.Text: Follow me.

Text: 裏路地を行こう

English.Text: We'll take the back way.

Text: どこへ行く？

English.Text: Stick close.

Text: なにをしている

English.Text: What're you doing?

Text: なにがあるかわからない　備えはしっかりな

English.Text: Never know what you're gonna run into out there. Best be prepared.

Text: 気をつけてな

English.Text: Careful out there.

Text: 異状なし

English.Text: Not here.

Text: チッ　どこに隠れてやがる

English.Text: Well, we know they're in town...

Text:
おい　そこのおまえ
不審者を見なかったか？

English.Text: Hey, you! Seen anyone acting suspicious?

Text: いえ　私はなにも……

English.Text: No, I haven't...

Text:
他に不審者を見かけたヤツはいないか！
見かけた者は　ただちに報告しろ

English.Text: The moment any of you see someone suspicious, inform the nearest trooper. Got it!?

Text: まだ見つからないのか　急ぐぞ！

English.Text: I want them found─now!

Text: ハッ！

English.Text: Sir!

Text: 貴様　なぜ逃げた！

English.Text: Hey, shithead! Why'd you run?

Text: いや　追いかけられたから……

English.Text: I was just scared, that's all!

Text: 怪しいな　なにを隠している！

English.Text: Scared we might find out what you been up to? That it?

Text: 現在　店内を捜査中だ

English.Text: We're currently conducting a search!

Text: 誰も中に入るな！

English.Text: No one's allowed inside!

Text:
申し訳ありませんが
ご協力をお願いします

English.Text: Excuse me. We have a few questions...

Text: いきなり　なんなんですか？

English.Text: Uhh, what is this about?

Text: 口答えせず　さっさと身分証を見せろ！

English.Text: Let's see some ID─and don't make me ask twice.

Text:
ミッドガルの魔晄炉をやったのは
君たちなんだろう？

English.Text:
I heard about the reactor bombings in Midgar.
That was you, wasn't it?

Text: 私は味方だ　本家に知り合いがいてね

English.Text: It's okay, I'm on your side. Got a contact at HQ.

Text: あんたも　アバランチか

English.Text: You're with Avalanche?

Text: 似たようなものだ

English.Text: Not exactly.

Text: 待て！

English.Text: Stop.

Text: 私が兵士の気を引こう

English.Text: I'll keep the troopers occupied.

Text: 君たちは　上の足場を渡れ

English.Text: While we're talking, you two go up and over.

Text: なにか　あったんですか？

English.Text: May I ask what's going on?

Text: 逃亡犯の捜索中だ

English.Text: We're searching for some fugitives.

Text: 怪しいやつを見なかったか？

English.Text: Have you seen anyone suspicious?

Text: ああ　どこかで見たような

English.Text: Now that you mention it, I think I might have...

Text:
いや　あれは違うか
いやでも……

English.Text: Though perhaps it was just my imagination. Or was it...?

Text: もういい　家に帰れ！

English.Text: Oh, for the love of─get outta here!

Text:
ちょっと待ってください
いま思い出しますから　えっと……

English.Text: Wait, wait! I know I saw some people who had a fugitive air about them! If only I could remember their faces...

Text: 捜索の邪魔だ　さっさと行け！

English.Text: Annoy someone else and stop wasting our time.

Text: アバランチは居たか？

English.Text: They turn up yet!?

Text: 順次　建物内を捜索中です

English.Text: No, but we're still searching buildings!

Text: 急げ　ネズミ１匹逃すな！

English.Text: Well, search harder! We gotta find 'em!

Text: うまくいったな

English.Text: That went well.

Text: 宿まであと少し　気を抜くな

English.Text: The inn's not much further, but stay on your toes.

Text: みんなは？

English.Text: Where are they?

Text: 下で待っている

English.Text: Down below─waiting for you.

Text:
地下道が街の外まで続いている
いまならまだ待ち伏せはないはずだ

English.Text: The tunnel in the basement will take you outside of town. Leave now and they won't catch you.

Text:
外に出たら　近くの農場に
私の知人がいるから頼るといい

English.Text: Head to the east. Friend of mine runs a farm out there. He'd be happy to help you.

Text: それと……

English.Text: Also...

Text: これを

English.Text: Take this.

Text: クラフト端末だ

English.Text: It's a transmuter.

Text:
共和国時代に作られた骨董品だが
『アイテムクラフト』ができるようになる

English.Text:
Converts raw materials into more practical items.
A republic antique, but it still works.

Text: よければ　使ってくれ

English.Text: You'll get more use out of it than me.

Text: 俺たちを行かせて　あんたは大丈夫なのか

English.Text: Why're you doin' this? Coulda just turned us in.

Text:
私も　この街も
神羅とは色々あってね

English.Text:
Yeah, I could've...but this town and I have
a history with Shinra.

Text: 正直　これが正しい道なのかはわからん

English.Text: Who knows? Maybe this'll turn out to be the worst decision I've ever made.

Text: 考えが変わる前に　さっさと行ってくれ

English.Text: So before I change my mind, you better get going.

Text: 『アイテムクラフト』のチュートリアルを確認しますか？

English.Text: View the item transmutation tutorial?

Text: はい

English.Text: Yes

Text: いいえ

English.Text: No

Text: うう……

English.Text: Urng...

Text: ゲホッゲホ……

English.Text: Khoff! Khoff! Hrng... Hahh...

Text: しばらくは　この街に近づかないほうがいい

English.Text: This goes without saying, but you'll have to lie low for a while.

Text:
農場のヤツには連絡しておく
寄ってみてくれ

English.Text:
I'll let my friend at the farm know you're coming...
It's all good.

Text: 幸運を祈るよ

English.Text: Best of luck to you.

Text: よかった　無事だったんだ

English.Text: You made it! All in one piece?

Text: ごめ～ん！

English.Text: Sorry we're late!

Text: ったく　ふたりでなにしてやがったんだ

English.Text: For the love of... Where the hell have you two been?

Text: デート　みたいな？

English.Text: On a date! Kind of.

Text: そういうのは　しばらくおあずけだ

English.Text:
Well, that was the last one!
Least till things calm down.

Text: いいな！

English.Text: Got that!?

Text: よし　脱出だ

English.Text: Now let's move.

Text: 行き止まり？

English.Text: Where to now?

Text: 風が流れている　こっちだ

English.Text: Where there's a draft. This way.

Text: オレの出番だな

English.Text: Looks like a job for me.

Text: 星って

English.Text: Just look at it all...

Text: 生きてるんだ

English.Text: It's so green.

Text: あらためて　そう思った

English.Text: ...A living, breathing planet.

Text: それに　わたしなんかより　ずっと強そう

English.Text:
Even after everything we've done to it,
it's still going strong.

Text: そう見えるだけだ

English.Text: It may look that way.

Text: だから人々は　崩壊の予兆に気づかない

English.Text: But in reality, it's barely hanging on.

Text: いろいろ　教えてね

English.Text: Guess I still have a lot to learn.

Text: なにが知りたいんだ？

English.Text: Whaddya wanna know?

Text: うーん　たとえば

English.Text: Hmm... For starters...

Text: 荒野の　歩き方？

English.Text: How do we cross these plains?

Text: そんなの　簡単だぜ

English.Text: C'mon now. That's easy.

Text: オレのやり方は

English.Text: The same way you get anywhere.

Text: とりあえず　歩き出せー！

English.Text: Pick a direction and start walkin'!

Text: カームには　しばらく戻れないよね

English.Text: I guess we won't be coming back anytime soon.

Text: そうだな

English.Text: Guess not.

Text: 行こう

English.Text: Let's go.

Text: これが本当のはじまり　だね

English.Text: And there it was! The first step on our new journey. You coming?

Text: よろしくな

English.Text: Follow me.

Text: おっしゃあ

English.Text: Alright!

Text: 行くぜ　行くぜ　行くぜ　行くぜー！

English.Text: Let's get this show on the road, people!

Text: おまえ　あのパイプがなにか知ってるか？

English.Text: You know what that metal monstrosity is, don'tcha?

Text: 魔晄パイプ

English.Text: It's a pipeline.

Text:
ミッドガルで汲み上げた魔晄を
ほかの街へ　輸送するためのものだ

English.Text: Moves mako pumped in Midgar to the outlying towns and wherever else.

Text:
あのパイプん中を流れてんのは　星の命だ
金儲けに使っていいもんじゃねえ

English.Text: Hmph... You call it a pipeline, but I call it a funnel─one that drains the planet's lifeblood into Shinra's pockets.

Text: あれも　いつかぶっ壊してやる

English.Text: Mark my words, I'm gonna put a stop to that.

Text: そうだ！

English.Text: Oh, I know!

Text:
パイプをひん曲げて　地面に突っ込んでよ
魔晄を星に返すってのはどうだ？

English.Text: How 'bout we break it in half and stick one end in the ground? That way, we'll really be givin' back to the planet!

Text: それは　名案だな

English.Text: There's an idea.

Text: ああ　名案だ

English.Text: Real genius one.

Text: いいかも？

English.Text: And...unique?

Text: 覚えておこう

English.Text: Very.

Text: おまえらー！

English.Text: Oh c'mon!

Text: 道路　ヒビだらけだね

English.Text: This road's seen better days...

Text:
共和国時代に作られた　古い道だ
整備をしなければ　こうなる

English.Text: Much of the republic's infrastructure has fallen into disrepair after years of neglect.

Text: 神羅は自分で使うとこしか　手入れしねえからな

English.Text: And you know damn well Shinra ain't about to spend a single gil on shit they don't use.

Text: 昔はバスが走ってたって　聞いたことがあるな

English.Text: Is it true the republic used to run buses between towns?

Text: バスは　共和国と一緒になくなった

English.Text: Yes, though that service ended when the war did.

Text:
つまり　オレたちが歩かされてんのは
神羅のせいってわけだ

English.Text: In other words, we gotta hoof it 'cause Shinra's run by tightwads.

Text:
でも　楽しい
ハイキングって　こんな感じ？

English.Text: Well, I don't mind. It's kinda fun exploring the great outdoors!

Text: 考え方次第だ

English.Text: You do you...

Text: 神羅の兵器？

English.Text: That thing Shinra's?

Text: ああ　でも　かなり古いな

English.Text: Looks like...but definitely an older model.

Text: 共和国と　ドンパチやってた頃のだろ？

English.Text:
From back when they were
dukin' it out with the republic.

Text: このあたりでも　戦争したんだね

English.Text: Hard to imagine this was once a battlefield.

Text:
この星は　歴史をさかのぼりゃ
戦争ばっかりだぜ

English.Text: And harder still to find land anywhere that hasn't been a battlefield at some point...

Text: あれはモンスター？　動物？

English.Text: Uh... Should we be worried about those things?

Text: 動物だ

English.Text: We're fine.

Text: どうして　わかるの？

English.Text: How can you be so sure?

Text: 図鑑で覚える　兵士の基本のひとつだ

English.Text:
'Cause I've read the field guide.
Like any good SOLDIER.

Text:
動物は食べるため　または縄張りを守るために襲う
だが　モンスターには理由がない

English.Text: Local wildlife will only attack while on the hunt, or in defense of their territory. Fiends, on the other hand, attack without reason.

Text: 襲われてからわかっても遅い

English.Text: If they're attacking, what does it matter?

Text:
あれに関して言えば　危険なニオイはしない
鼻を鍛えるんだな

English.Text: It matters if your nose can discern their intent before they attack─as I gather yours can't.

Text: まだ神羅がいやがるな

English.Text: Town's still crawlin' with troops.

Text: しばらくは　戻らないほうがいいだろう

English.Text: We should keep our distance for now.

Text: 私たちのこと　探してるのかな

English.Text: Yeah... We should get going.

Text: 迷惑　かけちゃったね

English.Text: This...kinda feels like our fault.

Text: いま行くと　捕まっちまうぞ

English.Text: Are you tryin' to get us caught?

Text: 神羅がいるうちは近づかないでおこう

English.Text: We can't risk attracting Shinra's attention.

Text: いまは　やめといたほうがよさそう

English.Text: Now might not be the best time.

Text: 神羅　いるね

English.Text: Let's not poke the bear.

Text: あんたら　アバランチだろ？

English.Text: You'd be the Avalanche folks?

Text:
心配するな
カームの宿屋から連絡があった

English.Text:
It's okay, I'm on your side.
Heard you'd be headin' my way.

Text:
神羅が本格的に　あんたらを探すらしい
ここも安全じゃないかもしれない

English.Text: You're safe here, but not for long. By the sound of it, Shinra's leavin' no stone unturned.

Text:
湿地帯のほうに使われていない船着き場がある
身を隠すには　いいかもしれないぞ

English.Text: Might wanna hole up at the old dock out by the swamp. I'd wager Shinra's forgotten it's even there.

Text:
悪いが　ここで匿うわけにはいかない
身を隠すなら湿地帯の船着き場がオススメだ

English.Text: Wish there was somethin' more I could do, but I ain't got the space to put you all up. The swamp's your best bet for now.

Text:
最近　モンスターが増えてるんだ
あんたらも　気をつけるんだな

English.Text: Seein' more fiends out and about every day. Watch yourselves, y'hear?

Text:
おやおや
こいつはみなさん　おそろいで

English.Text: Well, well! If it ain't my favorite group of hitchhikers!

Text: あっ！
トラックのおじさん

English.Text: Fancy meeting you here!

Text: あの時は　お世話になりました

English.Text: Thanks again for the ride to Kalm.

Text:
な～に　お嬢さんたちなら
いつでも大歓迎さ

English.Text: Ah, don't mention it. It's the least I could do for two such lovely young ladies.

Text: おっと　自己紹介がまだだったな

English.Text: But I do believe I neglected to introduce myself.

Text: わたしはグリン　以後お見知りおきを

English.Text:
The name's Bill, and you can count on me
for a lift anytime.

Text:
今日は　あいにく車の調子が悪くてね
乗せてやれないよ

English.Text: 'Cept today, that is. 'Fraid the old beaut's pulled up lame. Sorry 'bout that.

Text: 今日は大丈夫　ありがとう

English.Text:
No biggie─we're enjoying the fresh air.
Thanks though.

Text: このあたりで　人気のないところはないか

English.Text: You, uh...know someplace we can hunker down?

Text: 人気のないところ？

English.Text: Hmm... "Hunker down," y'say?

Text: まあ　若いうちは情熱に流されるものだからな

English.Text:
I'd almost forgotten what it was like to be
young and in love.

Text:
そうだな　湿地帯にある船着き場なら
誰もいないし静かだし　バッチリだと思うぞ

English.Text: Y'all just head straight that a-way, toward the swamplands. You'll find an abandoned building by the dock. I guarantee no one'll bother ya there!

Text: よければ　あとでうちの牧場にも寄ってくれ

English.Text: Swing by the ranch once you're done with whatever ya got goin' on.

Text: いまは手が離せないんだ　すまんね

English.Text: Love to keep chattin', but this rust bucket ain't gonna fix itself.

Text:
もう少しで牧場だっていうのに
このオンボロめ

English.Text:
Just had to start actin' up on me.
Temperamental old goat!

Text: 神羅は　いねえな

English.Text: No sign of Shinra.

Text: ああ

English.Text: Yeah.

Text: 共和国時代の船着き場だ

English.Text: Looks like an old republic landing.

Text: 昔は　船で湿地を渡ってたんだよな

English.Text: Could borrow a boat─make our way across...

Text:
で　ミスリルマインを抜ければ
ジュノンってわけだ

English.Text:
then head on through the mines
and keep goin' till we hit Junon.

Text: ああ　そのとおりだ

English.Text: Sure. Why not?

Text: だが　船は死んでいる

English.Text: You'd trust these rotting hulks?

Text: 乗って　みる？

English.Text: I mean, we could...

Text: 無理だな

English.Text: Let's not.

Text: そんじゃあ　泳ぐか！

English.Text: Then maybe...we swim it!

Text: 『湿地には　ミドガルズオルムが潜んでいます』

English.Text: "This swamp is home to the deadly Midgardsormr...

Text: ……だって

English.Text: "Beware."

Text: でも　チョコボのスピードなら大丈夫

English.Text: "But even if you're slow, you can rent a chocobo...

Text: さあ　チョコボで湿地を越えましょう

English.Text: "who'll see you safely past, being nothing if not fast...

Text: チョコボのご用命は　グリン牧場まで

English.Text: "So just give Bill the word, and he'll pick you out...

Text: だって！

English.Text: "a bird!"

Text: どうする？

English.Text: Well...?

Text: チョコボ　乗る？

English.Text: Can we rent some birds?

Text: 乗る？

English.Text: Can we?

Text: 行ってみよう

English.Text: Fine.

Text: チョコボで行くんじゃねえのか

English.Text: Gotta get chocobos, man.

Text: 徒歩で行くのは　危険だ

English.Text: Shouldn't swim this bog.

Text: チョコボを手に入れないと

English.Text: Chocobos first, remember?

Text: チョコボ　乗らないの？

English.Text: What happened to getting chocobos?

Text:
おやおや
こいつはみなさん　おそろいで

English.Text: Well, well! If it ain't my favorite group of hitchhikers!

Text: あっ！
トラックのおじさん

English.Text: Fancy meeting you here!

Text: あの時は　お世話になりました

English.Text: Thanks again for the ride to Kalm.

Text:
な～に　お嬢さんたちなら
いつでも大歓迎さ

English.Text: Ah, don't mention it. It's the least I could do for two such lovely young ladies.

Text: おっと　自己紹介がまだだったな

English.Text: But I do believe I neglected to introduce myself.

Text: わたしはグリン　以後お見知りおきを

English.Text:
The name's Bill, and you can count on me
for a lift anytime.

Text:
これはこれは　みなさん
ようこそ　グリン牧場へ

English.Text:
Pleasure to see y'all again.
And welcome to my humble ranch.

Text: トラック　直った？

English.Text: Manage to get your truck fixed?

Text:
お嬢さんたちと会って元気になったのか
なんとか　動いてくれたよ

English.Text:
Indeed I did. You must've been my lucky charms.
She started up right after ya left.

Text:
今日は？
もしかして　チョコボが入り用かな

English.Text: Anywho, what can I do ya for? You in the market for some fine feathered friends, by any chance?

Text: おうよ　湿地帯を越えたくてよ

English.Text:
Are we ever.
Need 'em to get through the swamplands.

Text: さすが　お目が高い

English.Text: Then you have come to the right place!

Text:
昔は国営の交通網があったが
ご存知のとおり　いまじゃまったくの役立たず

English.Text:
Back in the day, we had republic ferries to
get us from A to B. But now they're nothin'
but driftwood, sadly.

Text: そんな時代に便利なのが　チョコボ！

English.Text: We got the next best thing, though: chocobos.

Text: 特に湿地帯では　この上なく役に立つ

English.Text:
To them, a bottomless bog's
no worse'n a kiddie pool!

Text: お嬢さんがた

English.Text: Now, ladies...

Text:
チョコボが　どうやって
底なし沼を渡るか知ってますかな？

English.Text: You're prob'ly wonderin': what gives these birds the power to glide across swamps with ease?

Text: さあ……？

English.Text: Uh...

Text:
なんと　羽毛でプカプカと浮かびながら
強靭な脚で　スイスイ～っと泳ぐんですな

English.Text: Would you believe that their fluffy feathers give 'em the buoyancy to float, while their limber legs can outrun a motorboat!

Text:
そして　あの恐ろしいミドガルズオルムも
チョコボには追いつけないときたもんだ

English.Text: Not even the dreaded Midgardsormr─one of the fastest fiends around─can keep up with 'em!

Text: まあ　なにが言いたいかというと

English.Text: But you don't need convincin'.

Text: 湿地帯を越えるなら　チョコボが最善！

English.Text: You just need pointin' to a hardworkin' chocobo!

Text: それはもう　間違いなし

English.Text: Nature's two-legged limousine!

Text: ここで借りられるのか？

English.Text: So can we rent some?

Text: もちろん

English.Text: Sure can!

Text:
詳しいことは　あの小屋にいる
孫のグリングリンに聞いてくれ

English.Text:
My grandson Billy's in the stable over yonder.
He'll help ya out.

Text: なにか　質問かな？

English.Text: Hmm? There something I can help you with?

Text: なにか　質問かな？

English.Text: "There something I can help you with?"

Text: ミドガルズオルムについて

English.Text: I wanna know about Midgardsormr.

Text: チョコボについて

English.Text: A chocobo would be nice.

Text: 質問はない

English.Text: Nope. Nothing.

Text:
ミドガルズオルムとは　湿地帯に棲む
身の丈１０メートルを超える怪物的ヘビのことだな

English.Text: Ah, that'd be the serpent that lives in the swamp. Longer than a river, quieter than a whisper, and quicker than a lightning bolt!

Text:
湿地帯に入り込んだ人や動物の気配を察知しては
音もなく忍び寄り　バクッと襲いかかるわけだ

English.Text: Cause the water to so much as ripple, it'll come barrelin' after ya, gapin' maw and all. Whew...gives me chills just thinkin' 'bout it.

Text:
そんなやつらも
チョコボのスピードには追いつけない

English.Text: Lucky for you, most chocobos can outrun the devil.

Text:
これ　経験豊かな旅人なら
だれでも知ってる豆知識

English.Text:
Though I'm sure you already knew that.
Any man of the road would've heard the tales.

Text: おまえさんは　当然知ってるって顔だな

English.Text: And judgin' by that sword, ya been the subject of a few yourself.

Text: だろう？

English.Text: 'Course ya have.

Text:
わたしは　チョコボと人を見る目には
自信があるんだ

English.Text: If there's one thing I know 'sides chocobos, it's how to spot a seasoned frontiersman.

Text:
ミドガルズオルムは湿地帯に生息する
ヘビのバケモノだよ

English.Text: Midgardsormr's an ornery beast of a serpent. Made a home for itself in the wetlands southwest of here.

Text:
彼らに襲われないためにも
チョコボが最善の選択ってわけだ

English.Text: Wanna make it across that swamp with all your limbs still attached? Then best get yourself a bird.

Text:
詳しいことは　チョコボ小屋にいる
グリングリンに聞いてくれ

English.Text:
You might could talk to Billy over in the stables.
He'll be happy to tell ya all ya need to know.

Text:
おお　逃げたチョコボを捕まえてくれるんだって？
頼んだよ

English.Text: I hear you have to wrangle yourselves a wild chocobo! Best of luck to y'all.

Text:
トラックの調子がいいうちに
看板の点検に行っとくかな

English.Text: Pro'ly oughta go'n check on the signs before my truck decides to die on me again.

Text:
神羅軍が　カームを封鎖してるらしい
おまえさんたち　なにか知ってるか？

English.Text: Little birdie told me Shinra's military closed off Kalm. Y'all wouldn't happen to know anythin' about that, now wouldja?

Text: いらっしゃい！

English.Text: Howdy!

Text:
看板を見た
湿地帯用のチョコボを借りたい

English.Text:
Saw the sign.
Need some chocobos to cross the swamp.

Text: あ～　おじさんたち　運が悪い

English.Text: Um, sorry, pops, but you're outta luck.

Text: おじ……

English.Text: "Pops"?

Text: レンタル用のチョコボは　みんな貸し出し中なんだ

English.Text: Got no more birds. Last one went this morning.

Text: いっぱい　いるじゃねえか

English.Text: Coulda fooled me, kid.

Text: いまいるのは療養中か　契約済みの子だよ

English.Text: These're spoken for. That or they're not fit for riding.

Text: でも　まあ

English.Text: But...

Text:
おじさんたちが　もっと高値で借りてくれる
って言うなら　譲ってもいいよ

English.Text:
I can see you're in a bind, so I'll bump you up
the list─for a price, of course.

Text: いくらだよ

English.Text: Which is?

Text: １０万以上

English.Text: Ten grand each.

Text: ごめんね

English.Text: The thing is...

Text: わたしたち　旅の途中で　そんなに払えないの

English.Text: we don't have that kind of money. Or any, really.

Text: それなら　いい情報があるんだ

English.Text: Well, there is one other option...

Text: 情報料　１０００ギル

English.Text: Only cost you a grand.

Text: と　言いたいところだけど

English.Text: ...Is what a scoundrel might say...

Text: 美人を困らせたくないから　タダでいいや

English.Text: but I wouldn't dream of distressing y'all further.

Text:
実は　すこし前に牧場から逃げだして
そのまま野生化しちゃったチョコボがいるんだ

English.Text:
Just so happens one of our birds ran off
the other day─wild thing, but still a fine chocobo.

Text:
もし　そいつを捕まえてくれたら
お姉さんたちのものにしていいよ

English.Text:
If you can manage to find and catch him,
then he's yours─free of charge.

Text: ほんとに？

English.Text: You sure?

Text: 名前は『ピコ』

English.Text: Yeah, why not?

Text:
ちょっと気難しいヤツで
放牧してたら　いつの間にか逃げちゃったんだ

English.Text:
Name's Piko...
The hardest-headed bird you'll ever meet─by far.

Text: おじさんに　雰囲気が似てるかも

English.Text: And he's the spittin' image of pops here.

Text: まず　ピコの足あとを探して

English.Text: You can start by lookin' for his tracks.

Text: 足あとがあれば　その近くにいるはずだよ

English.Text:
Find those, and you're sure to
find the feet that made 'em.

Text: 野良になったチョコボは　すごく用心深いけど

English.Text:
Now, wild chocobos can be a bit
skittish around people...

Text:
気づかれないように近づければ
お姉さんたちでも　捕まえられると思うな

English.Text: but if you play it cool and creep up real quiet-like, you'll wrangle him no problem!

Text: うん　わかった　ありがとう

English.Text: I think we can do that. Thanks.

Text: あと　これ重要

English.Text: And one last thing.

Text:
情報をタダにしたんだ
必ず　うちの店で買い物をすること

English.Text: This info comes free of charge─provided you promise to stop by our shop.

Text: 妹のクリンが売ってるから　まずは見てってよ

English.Text:
Speak to Chloe back there.
She'll sell ya whatever ya need.

Text: 商売がうめえな

English.Text: Kid's a born businessman.

Text:
チョコボを捕まえたら
いちど　うちに連れてくるといいよ

English.Text:
If y'all can catch our runaway
and get his butt back here...

Text: 乗り方や育て方を　教えてあげる

English.Text: ridin' and rearin' lessons are on me.

Text: クリンのお店　見てってよ

English.Text: You check out the shop yet?

Text: お金ないなら　見るだけでもいいからさ

English.Text: Even if you're flat broke, just humor me.

Text: チョコボの質問？

English.Text: Need somethin'?

Text: チョコボの質問？

English.Text: "Need somethin'?"

Text: チョコボがいる場所について

English.Text: How can I find wild chocobos?

Text: チョコボの捕まえ方について

English.Text: How do I catch a wild chocobo?

Text: チョコボの装具品について

English.Text: Tell me about riding gear.

Text: 質問はない

English.Text: Nope.

Text:
外に出たら　まずチョコボの足あとを探すんだ
そのあたりにいるよ　きっと

English.Text: Start by looking for fresh tracks. Once you spot 'em, birds're rarely more than a stone's throw away.

Text: 野生化したチョコボは　警戒心が強いからね

English.Text: Birds in the wild're much more skittish than kept ones.

Text:
気づかれないように
こっそり近づくのがコツだよ

English.Text: Gonna have to be real quiet on the approach, else they'll bolt.

Text: ピコのこと　よろしく頼むよ

English.Text: Good luck wranglin' Piko!

Text:
チョコボに装具品をつけることで　格好よくしたり
チョコボレースの能力をパワーアップできるんだ

English.Text: Gear serves all sortsa purposes, from the cosmetic to the practical. Can even improve a race bird's performance.

Text:
『黄金の羽根』と交換してるから
そっちもよろしくね

English.Text: Won't cost you a gil─golden plumes only.

Text: お兄ちゃんが　お金お金ってごめんなさい

English.Text:
Sorry about my brother.
All he thinks about is money.

Text: お仕事だからね　気にしないで

English.Text: He's just doing his job. We understand.

Text:
そうなんだけど　パパとママがいなくなってから
とってもお金にうるさくなって

English.Text: I suppose, but he's been a real pain about it ever since our parents...left.

Text: お姉さん　ミッドガルから来たの？

English.Text: Say...are you guys from Midgar?

Text: うん　スラムから

English.Text: Yeah. The undercity.

Text: チョコボ・サムって　知ってる？

English.Text: Then, do you happen to know Chocobo Sam?

Text:
知ってるっていうか……
うん　知ってる

English.Text: Um... Not very well, but... Yeah, I guess we do.

Text: どこにいるの？

English.Text: Where is he?

Text: 六番街のスラムだろうな

English.Text: Probably the Sector 6 slums.

Text: ウォール――

English.Text: He's a big deal in Wall─

Text: サムに　会いたいの？

English.Text: Um...why do you ask?

Text: う～ん　わかんない

English.Text: I was thinking about reaching out.

Text: その人　パパとママの“かたき”なの

English.Text: It's his fault Mom and Dad are gone, so...

Text: クリン　その話はお客さんにはしないよ

English.Text: Chloe! That's none of these good folks' business.

Text: でも……

English.Text: But they could help!

Text: いまの話は　よそでしないでよね

English.Text: Don't tell anyone what she told you.

Text:
サムはチョコボ業界の大物だから
変な噂が立ったら　うちなんかすぐに潰されちゃう

English.Text:
Sam's one of the biggest names in the business.
If he gets wind of that story, our ranch is done for.

Text: うん　わかった　だれにも言わない

English.Text: Don't worry─your secret's safe with us. I promise.

Text:
ピコを捕まえたら
この野菜　あげてみてください

English.Text:
Oh! Take these greens.
You can give them to Piko when you find him.

Text:
ピコは　特に野菜が好きだったから
ここに戻ってきたくなると思うんです

English.Text:
They were always his favorite treat, you see...
Maybe he'll come back once he's had a taste!

Text: それじゃ　お店も見ていってください

English.Text: Right... Should prob'ly sell you stuff, huh?

Text:
お兄ちゃんは　必ず買えなんて言ってたけど
いいものがあったらでいいんで　買ってください

English.Text: Billy'll throw a fit if I don't at least try to get you to spend a few gil. No pressure, but if anything catches your eye...

Text:
あと　チョコボの装具品と
『黄金の羽根』の交換も受け付けてるんで

English.Text:
Also, if you have any golden plumes on you,
I can exchange them for chocobo gear.

Text: そちらも　よろしくお願いします

English.Text: So, be sure to hand 'em over if you do!

Text: ピコのこと　よろしくお願いします

English.Text: I hope Piko doesn't give you all too much trouble!

Text: チョコボのことは　うちにおまかせください

English.Text: We're a one-stop shop for all your chocobo needs!

Text: いらっしゃいませ

English.Text: Welcome, folks!

Text: 今日は　どれにします？

English.Text: Hi. How can I help you today?

Text: ありがとうございました

English.Text: Thank you for stopping by!

Text: また来てくださいね

English.Text: We hope to serve you again!

Text: いつでも　遊びにきてくださいね

English.Text: You're welcome back here anytime!

Text:
チョコボをお着替えさせるときは
そこの『チョコ房』を使ってください

English.Text: If you ever wanna change your chocobo's gear, feel free to use the stable just over there.

Text: そんじゃあ　チョコボ探しといくか

English.Text: Alright, Beak-o! Where'd you run off to?

Text: 名前は　ピコ！

English.Text: You mean "Piko"?

Text: まず　足あとだよね

English.Text: Let's try looking for some tracks.

Text: いたぞ

English.Text: Bingo.

Text:
よっしゃあ！
あとは　とっ捕まえるだけだな

English.Text: Yeah! C'mon, y'all, let's go bag us a chocobo!

Text: 静かに　狩りの基本は相手に気づかせないことだ

English.Text:
Keep it down. When you're on the hunt,
you don't wanna startle your prey.

Text: 狩り？　友達になるんだよね

English.Text: "Prey"? You know we're not here to kill him, right?

Text: ああ……

English.Text: Yeah...

Text: クエ　クエ～！

English.Text: Kweh!

Text: かわいい～

English.Text: Aw, isn't he just the cutest?

Text: たしかに　似てるかも

English.Text: You know, they are kinda similar!

Text: なんだ　どうした？

English.Text: What does he want now?

Text: まだ　おなか減ってるのかも

English.Text: Do you think maybe he's still hungry?

Text: ごめんね　もう持ってないの

English.Text: Sorry... That's all the food we had.

Text: クエ……

English.Text: Kweh...

Text: 牧場に戻れば　たくさんあるよ

English.Text: But you know where there's more? Bill's place!

Text: クエ！

English.Text: Kweh!

Text: 牧場へ戻るようだな

English.Text: Back to the ranch it is, then.

Text: 追いかけよ

English.Text: C'mon!

Text: いたいた！

English.Text: Ah, there's our guy!

Text: 野菜で　おうちのこと　思い出した？

English.Text: Nothing beats a little taste of home, now does it?

Text: うん　ケガもしてないし大丈夫だね

English.Text: Not so much as a feather outta place.

Text: むしろ　たくましくなってる

English.Text: Got one healthy bird here.

Text: 乗れそうか？

English.Text: 'Nough to ride?

Text: いまは空腹で気が立ってるから　無理かな

English.Text: Sure, though I wouldn't try till he's done eating.

Text:
でも　しっかり食べて
気持ちが落ちつけば　大丈夫だと思う

English.Text: Once he's had his fill though, I'm sure he'll come round to the idea...if we ask him nice.

Text:
乗れるように準備しておくから
それまで　外で待っててよ

English.Text:
I'll need to prep his gear and all that,
so why don't you wait outside?

Text:
人がいると　ピコが落ちつかないから
外で待っててよ

English.Text: Piko doesn't much like eatin' when strangers are nearby.

Text: もう少し　かかりそうかな

English.Text: Mind waitin' outside for a bit?

Text: ピコを連れ戻してくれて　ありがとうございます

English.Text: I really can't thank you enough for bringing Piko back to us!

Text: クラウドさん！

English.Text: Hey, Cloud!

Text: おまえは……

English.Text: Hey there.

Text: ボクです　チャドリーです！

English.Text: What a pleasant surprise!

Text:
あれ……
もしかして　お忘れですか？

English.Text: You...do remember me...don't you?

Text: もしかして　お忘れですか？

English.Text: "You...do remember me...don't you?"

Text: 覚えていない

English.Text: Nope...

Text: もちろん覚えている

English.Text: Yeah...

Text: すまない

English.Text: Nope...

Text: そう……ですか

English.Text: Really? Not at all?

Text:
クラウドさんにとって
ボクなんて　その程度の存在なのですね

English.Text:
It...seems I didn't make as strong
an impression as I thought.

Text: 残念です

English.Text: Silly me.

Text: では　あらためて自己紹介させてください

English.Text: Well! Allow me to refresh your memory!

Text: ボクの名前は　チャドリー

English.Text: My name's Chadley.

Text: ミッドガルで　マテリアの研究をしていた者です

English.Text: I was the one researching materia in Midgar.

Text:
クラウドさんとはスラムで出会い　研究に必要な
バトルレポートの提出をお願いしました

English.Text: We first met in the Sector 7 undercity, where I asked you to provide me with battle intel.

Text:
ミッドガルでは　何度となくお話をし
とてもよくしてもらったのですが

English.Text:
Though brief, we had multiple interactions
through which we got to know each other.

Text: どうでしょう　すこしは思い出されましたか？

English.Text: How was that? Ring any bells, perhaps?

Text: ああ

English.Text: Yeah...

Text: よかった　うれしいです

English.Text: Great! What a relief!

Text: よかった！

English.Text: I knew you would!

Text:
ミッドガルでは　数々のバトルレポートの提出
ありがとうございました

English.Text:
It was an absolute pleasure working with you
in Midgar. Thank you again!

Text:
おかげさまで　たくさんのマテリアを
生成することができました

English.Text:
Your invaluable intel allowed me to create
so much materia!

Text:
どうしておまえがこんなところに？
という　困惑を検知

English.Text:
Detecting internal monologue...
"The hell's this weirdo doing here?"

Text: ボクは　宝条によって造られたサイボーグですよ

English.Text: I was created by Professor Hojo, you know.

Text:
クラウドさんの感情を読み取ることぐらい
簡単です

English.Text: Though your thoughts could be read by any cyborg.

Text:
実は　ボクもクラウドさんたちを見習って
ミッドガルから飛び出し

English.Text: But, to answer your question, I took a page out of your book and skipped town.

Text: 世界中を見てまわることにしたんです

English.Text: Now the whole world's my laboratory.

Text:
そこで　折り入って
クラウドさんにお願いしたいことがあるのですが

English.Text:
Speaking of which, I have a favor to ask─
if it's not too much trouble.

Text: 戦闘データの収集か

English.Text: You need more battle intel.

Text: さすがクラウドさん　話が早いですね

English.Text:
That's the Cloud I know.
Always eager to get on with it.

Text:
でも　その前に
『通信塔』を起動していただきたいんです

English.Text: But yes...though I'd like you to activate some remnawave towers first.

Text:
かつて　ジュノン共和国が世界中に建設した
通信塔を　神羅が接収したのですが

English.Text: They were originally constructed by the Republic of Junon, but were claimed by Shinra after the war...

Text: そのまま使われることなく　放置されてるんです

English.Text: since which time they've sat idle and untouched.

Text: だったら　ボクのものにしてもいいかなって

English.Text: Just waiting for someone to put them to good use.

Text:
各地にある通信塔を起動していくごとに
ボクの演算処理能力が強化され

English.Text:
The more towers you activate around the world,
the more my processing power will grow...

Text: 探索領域を広げることができます

English.Text: as will the area I can survey.

Text:
また　神羅に関与されない通信網を
構築することだって可能です

English.Text: I might even be able to construct a communications network independent of Shinra.

Text:
いかがでしょう？
クラウドさんにとっても　有益かと思うのですが

English.Text: How does that sound? You'd not only be helping me, but yourselves as well.

Text: 見つけたら　起動しておこう

English.Text: If we find any, we'll turn 'em on.

Text:
クラウドさんなら
そう言ってくれると信じていました

English.Text: Wonderful. I thought you might say something like that.

Text:
では　早速ですが
あそこにある通信塔の起動をお願いします

English.Text:
Let's get started, then.
See that tower? That's your first target.

Text: これが　起動モジュールです

English.Text: And this will activate it.

Text: それでは　今回はボクがご案内しますね

English.Text: As the tower is close by, allow me to accompany you.

Text: クラウドさん　こっちですよ？

English.Text: Hey, Cloud! It's this way!

Text: しっかり　ついてきてください！

English.Text: Please, don't wander off.

Text: こちらです

English.Text: Here we are.

Text: 通信塔の起動を確認！

English.Text: Tower activation confirmed.

Text: 早速　グラスランドエリアの探索を開始し

English.Text: Initiating preliminary scan of the grasslands.

Text:
モンスターの生息地
採取可能な素材などを割り出しています

English.Text:
I'll ascertain the locations of fiends
and natural resources.

Text:
おまえさんたち
これから　湿地帯へ行くんだろ？

English.Text:
Lemme guess. Y'all are fixin' to
finally cross the swamplands, right?

Text: うん　そのつもり

English.Text: Yeah, that's the plan.

Text: ついさっき　看板を点検しとったら

English.Text:
While I was makin' a routine inspection
of my signage...

Text:
黒いマントを着た連中が
ふらふら～っと　湿地帯へ入っていくのを見てな

English.Text: group of fellas shambled on by, headin' toward the bog. Looked like a funeral procession, what with their black robes.

Text: 黒マント？

English.Text: Black robes?

Text:
チョコボに乗らんと危ないぞ～と言ったんだが
行っちまいおった

English.Text: Yes indeed. Told 'em they'd need some chocobos for safe passage, but I ain't even sure they heard me.

Text:
あのままだと
ミドガルズオルムのエサになっちまう

English.Text:
I expect Midgardsormr will
make a meal out of those boys.

Text:
もし見かけたら　うちに寄るよう
声をかけてくれんか

English.Text:
But if you do catch up to 'em first,
try to convince 'em to swing by the ranch.

Text:
ジュノン側に　古い友がやってる
チョコボ牧場があるから良ければ寄ってやってくれ

English.Text: Friend of mine from way back runs a chocobo ranch out near Junon. If you find the time, pay him a visit.

Text: チョコボにまたがれば　世界がグーンと広がるぞ！

English.Text: The moment ya get on a chocobo, your world gets a hundred million times bigger.

Text:
湿地を渡るなら
チョコボを呼んだほうがいい

English.Text: If we're crossing the swamp, we'll need to rely on chocobos.

Text: 本当に渡れんだろうな？

English.Text: So...we sure this is safe?

Text:
底なし沼もあるって話じゃねえか
それに　ヘビのバケモンも出るんだろ？

English.Text: Heard pockets of the bog're damn near bottomless. Plus, there's that giant man-eatin' serpent.

Text: チョコボなら大丈夫って言ってたけど

English.Text: Bill assured us the chocobos could handle it.

Text: この子たち　信じよ

English.Text: Have some faith in our feathered friends!

Text: クエ～！

English.Text: Kweh!

Text: あれを見ろ

English.Text: Over there!

Text: セフィロスだ

English.Text: It's Sephiroth.

Text: ほんと？

English.Text: What!?

Text: 追うぞ

English.Text: Come on.

Text: セフィロス　いねえな

English.Text: I don't see Sephiroth...do you?

Text: うん　そうだね……

English.Text: No... I don't.

Text: ゴール　見えてきたね

English.Text: Is that dry land I see!?

Text: 急ごう

English.Text: Let's go.

Text: なんだ　どうした！

English.Text: Whoa, easy there!

Text: なにっ？

English.Text: What the─!?

Text: おいおいおいおいおい！

English.Text: Hey! Get back here right now!

Text: 島に擬態していたようだな

English.Text: It disguised itself as an island.

Text: 解説ありがとよ

English.Text: Gee, I hadn't noticed.

Text: 来るぞ！

English.Text: Focus!

Text: 離れろ！

English.Text: Get back!

Text: 逃げた？

English.Text: Is it gone?

Text: クラウド！

English.Text: Cloud!

Text: そんな……

English.Text: No...

Text: もしもーし

English.Text: Wakey wakey!

Text: わたし　わかる？

English.Text: You remember who I am?

Text: エアリス……

English.Text: Aerith...

Text: おかえり　クラウド

English.Text: It's good to have you back, Cloud.

Text: セフィロスは？

English.Text: Sephiroth?

Text: やっぱり　セフィロスは強いな

English.Text: I knew he was strong, but still...

Text:
あの連中も
セフィロスを追っているのかもしれない

English.Text: Those guys're looking for him too. They've gotta be.

Text: うん　そんな感じ　するね

English.Text: Yeah... I kinda get that feeling as well.

Text: 俺たちも行こう

English.Text: Let's not lose 'em.

Text:
クラウドさん　エンシェントマターは
その近くにあるはずです

English.Text: Cloud! The protorelic should be somewhere in your vicinity.

Text:
それらしいものがないか
入念な調査をお願いします

English.Text: It may not be in plain sight, but I trust you'll be able to find it.

Text: ふんが～！

English.Text: Hahhh!

Text:
うひひひひ！
こりゃ　ネウチモンにちがいねえ

English.Text: Hyahaha! Yep, this here's something that'll appreciate.

Text: うへへへへ　ネウチネウチ！

English.Text: Hahaha! Hell yeah! I 'preciate it!

Text: うん　ネウチってなんだ？

English.Text: Wait, what are we appreciating?

Text:
バカ！
ネウチってのは……あれだ

English.Text: When somethin' appreciates, it, uh...

Text: お宝ってこった　なあ！

English.Text: It means it's worth a shitload of gil! Right?

Text: おうよ　これで足が洗えるぞ

English.Text: Right! Which means we can finally go legit.

Text:
もう　盗賊団じゃねえ
『ベグカンパニー』だ！

English.Text: Gentlemen! Today we're founding "Beck's Business"!

Text:
おめえら
ほかにもお宝がねえか探すぞ

English.Text: Quit slackin' off and see if there's any other treasures around here!

Text:
ネウチモン　ネウチモン
ネウチモン！

English.Text: You got it, Boss! I'm real good at appreciatin' things!

Text: おっ宝～　おっ宝～！

English.Text: Yoo-hoo, oh appreciatin' treasure!

Text: ふご～　ふご～　ふご～　ふご～！

English.Text: Heh! Hah! Ohoohoo!

Text: あん？

English.Text: Huh?

Text: って　あぎゃ！

English.Text: Oh shit!

Text: うひゃ！

English.Text: Oh shit!

Text: ひぎゃ！

English.Text: Oh shit!

Text: ふがっ！

English.Text: Doh shur!

Text: てっ　てめえら　なんでここに！

English.Text: Th-the hell you people doin' here!?

Text: てめえら　なんでここに？

English.Text: "The hell you people doin' here?"

Text: 誰だ？

English.Text: Who're you?

Text: ここでなにをしている

English.Text: What're you doing here?

Text: なにを見つけた？

English.Text: What did you find?

Text: 見つけたものを渡せ

English.Text: Hand it over. Now.

Text:
おい　オレたちベグ盗賊団を
忘れたとは言わせねえぜ

English.Text: Oh, hell no! Don't you dare act like you've forgotten Beck's Badasses.

Text:
スラムで　のんびり暮らしていただけなのに
何度も襲いやがって

English.Text: Yeah, you waltzed into our home and beat us to shit! We hadn't even done nothin'!

Text: そうだ　そうだ！

English.Text: Ya big jerks!

Text:
おめえらのせいで
ゼンリョウな盗賊団はカイメツだ！

English.Text: You're responsible for the destruction of our charitable organization!

Text: そう　だっけ？

English.Text: Oh, are we?

Text: なんの話だ

English.Text: News to me.

Text:
フッフッフッフ　オレたちにスラムは狭すぎた
こっからは　世界テンカイよお！

English.Text: Heh heh heh... Midgar isn't big enough for us. We're takin' our operations worldwide!

Text: 足を洗って『カンパニー』だ～！

English.Text: We've gone legit─we're a business now!

Text: なに言ってんだ　こいつら

English.Text: They're a special kind of stupid.

Text:
魔晄を見つけた神羅みたいに
オレらもお宝で　でっかくなるってワケよ！

English.Text: If Shinra can take over the world with mako, then all we gotta do is find our own treasures, and then we'll be on top!

Text:
いっししし
ネウチモンで　カンパニーだ～！

English.Text: Hee hee... Yeah, we're gonna appreciate all the things!

Text: ハッハー　とんでもねえネウチモンよ！

English.Text: Haha! Wouldn't you like to know!

Text:
見た目はボロいし
どういうブツかもわかんねえが

English.Text: I mean, I would too─and it looks like crap─but...!

Text:
とにかく　すげえエネルギーを
ビンビン感じるぜ！

English.Text: It's definitely pulsin' with a ridiculous amount of power!

Text: これを売れば　オレたちは大金持ちだ！

English.Text: Once we flip it, we'll be swimmin' in lakes of gil!

Text: それって　もしかして

English.Text: Hey, Cloud. Isn't that...

Text: てめえらも　お宝目当てか？

English.Text: Hold on, now you're after our treasure!?

Text: オレたちが　先に見つけたんだぞ？

English.Text: Well, sucks to be you! We found it!

Text: ネウチモンは　オレたちのもんだ！

English.Text: Yeah, we're the only ones who can appreciate it!

Text: ふんだ　ふんだ！

English.Text: Mhm! Mhm!

Text: おとなしく渡すんだな

English.Text: Hand it over. Now.

Text: けっ　そんな脅しに屈するオレたちじゃ――

English.Text: Hah! You really think that's enough to intimidate the likes of...

Text:
ダメだ　もうおしまいだあ！
うううう　おしまいだ……

English.Text: No, please! It's all yours! Just don't hurt us again!

Text: 死んだふり　死んだふりー！

English.Text: Play dead! Play dead!!! I'm so dead...

Text: おめえら　落ちつけ！

English.Text: Would you all quit freakin' out!?

Text:
いいか　よく聞け
とっておきの作戦がある

English.Text: Now listen here, numb nuts. I got a foolproof plan.

Text: その名も　『オトリ作戦』だ！

English.Text: I call it...use a decoy!

Text: おお　オトリか！

English.Text: Oh! A decoy!

English.Text: The key ain't goin' nowhere. Just leave it!

Text: ずいぶんと　手こずられているようですね

English.Text: I suppose we all have our "off days."

Text: 泳がせているだけだ

English.Text: I want them to get away.

Text:
アジトまで誘導させて叩く
最初から　そのつもりだった

English.Text: That's the plan. Once they lead us to their hideout...then we hit 'em.

Text: なるほど　さすがです

English.Text: I'm sorry to have ever doubted you.

Text:
追跡を再開する前に
盗賊さんが埋めた鍵を探してみてください

English.Text: Before you resume your hunt, however, I'll need you to unearth the key they buried.

Text: チョコボの嗅覚なら　発見できるはずです

English.Text: It shouldn't be too tough if you have a chocobo.

Text: クラウドさん　チョコボを呼んでみてください

English.Text: I think you might want to call a chocobo, Cloud.

Text:
まず　盗賊さんのニオイが残っているものを
探してみてください

English.Text: To begin your search, have your chocobo sniff something with the bandits' scent.

Text:
合鍵は埋められたようです
スコップを調べてみてはどうでしょう

English.Text: As they buried the key, it's likely they used those shovels over there to do it.

Text:
クラウドさん　盗賊さんがこの辺りに
アジトの合鍵を埋めてしまいました

English.Text: Cloud, just a friendly reminder. Those bandits buried a key you need nearby.

Text: チョコボで探してみてください

English.Text: You can use a chocobo to find it.

Text: クエッ！

English.Text: Kweh!

Text: 合鍵を発見されたみたいですね

English.Text: Looks like you found the key. Great!

Text: 逃げた盗賊団はアジトへ帰ったようです

English.Text: And in other news, the bandits have stopped running.

Text:
今度こそ　エンシェントマターの回収を
お願いします！

English.Text: Let's hope that the fourth time will be the proverbial charm.

Text: あの建物です

English.Text: That's the building.

Text: 元々は神羅が管轄していた倉庫だったようです

English.Text: At one point, it was used for the storage of Shinra property.

Text:
どんな罠が仕掛けられているかわかりません
くれぐれも気をつけてください

English.Text: But the bandits have since turned it into a hideout─and probably filled it with traps.

Text: クラウドさん

English.Text: Cloud.

Text:
しばらくグラスランドから離れていたようなので
状況を説明します

English.Text: This is your first time back in a while, so I'd like to remind you where things stand.

Text:
現在　盗賊団が
エンシェントマターを持って逃亡中です

English.Text: You're in pursuit of some bandits who got their hands on a protorelic.

Text: いまは　あの建物に潜伏しているようです

English.Text: Right now, they're holed up in that abandoned warehouse.

Text:
どんな罠が仕掛けられているかわかりません
くれぐれも気をつけてください

English.Text: There's no telling what kind of security measures they have in place, so be on your guard.

Text:
アニキ　なんでオレたち
アジトで死んだふりしてんだ？

English.Text: Hey, Boss. I don't get it. Why are we playing dead in the hideout?

Text:
バカ　なんでも屋をだますために
決まってんだろ

English.Text: Obviously so we can pull one over on the merc, dumbass!

Text: ああ～

English.Text: Oh...

Text: 死んだふりで　だませるのか？

English.Text: Pull one over while dead?

Text: ちったあアタマ使え

English.Text: Try usin' that brain of yours.

Text:
死んでるヤツは　もうコロせないだろ？
だから　襲っても無駄ってワケだ

English.Text: You can't make a dead guy any deader, right? He'd be wastin' his time attackin' us─so he won't!

Text: なるほど～！

English.Text: 'Cause we're dead!

Text: へへへ……

English.Text: Heh heh heh...

Text:
これぞ　オレたちのオイエゲイ
『シンダフリ作戦』よ

English.Text: Exactly. That's why the possum posse trick is foolproof!

Text: シンダフリ作戦……

うう……いつまで
死んだふりしてればいいんだ？

English.Text: So...how long we gotta stay dead?

Text: がんばれ　もうすこしのシンボウだ

English.Text: Till the coast is clear. Now suck it up.

Text: このまま　本当に死んだりしないよね？

English.Text: Yeah. It's not like we're gonna die for real.

Text: 大丈夫だ

English.Text: It's all good.

Text: 死ぬかもな

English.Text: Am I dead?

Text: ぐう……ぐう……

English.Text: Zzz... Zzz...

Text:
ぐう……ふがっ！
ぐう……ぐう……

English.Text: Zzz... Ngah... Zzz...

Text: うう……

English.Text: Ugh...

Text: うあ……

English.Text: Gah!

Text: ああ～……

English.Text: Argh!

Text: うう……

English.Text: Erg...

Text: うう……

English.Text: Ugh...

Text: ふが……！

English.Text: Whar!

Text: おい　てめえら！

English.Text: The hell ya think you're doin'!?

Text:
死人をもてあそびやがって
血もナミダもねえのか

English.Text: Disfiguring defenseless corpses─you should be ashamed!

Text: 生きてんじゃねえか！

English.Text: "Corpses," huh?

Text:
なあ　オレたちの仲じゃねえか
ここはシンシ同士　話し合いで解決しようぜ

English.Text: Now listen. What I'm tryin' to say here is, we don't gotta resort to violence. We can talk things out like gentlemen.

Text: 話し合いで解決しようぜ？

English.Text: "We can talk things out like gentlemen."

Text: 話を聞く

English.Text: Sure.

Text: いくらだ？

English.Text: How much for the relic?

Text: 話すことはない

English.Text: Got nothing to say to you.

Text: オレたちは　たしかに盗賊だ

English.Text: Okay, so we may be thieves...

Text:
でもよ　これは盗んだんじゃねえ
見つけたもんだ

English.Text:
But we didn't steal nothin' this time, I swear!
We found it!

Text: ショユーケンはオレたちにある　だろ？

English.Text: And possession is nine-tenths of the law, ain't it?

Text: う～ん　言われてみれば

English.Text: Hmm, that's a good point.

Text:
だからよ　どうしても欲しいんなら
売ってやるよ　どうだ？

English.Text:
How 'bout this? If you want it that badly,
we'll sell it to ya. Whaddya say?

Text: １万ギルで　どうだ？

English.Text: Ten grand sounds fair to me.

Text: ふざけるな

English.Text: You wish.
Okay...nine.

Text: 話にならない

English.Text: Keep dreaming.
Fine, seven Gs!

Text: ダメだ

English.Text: No.

Text: コーショーケツレツだ！

English.Text: This dispute's goin' to arbitrary!

Text: こっちがシタテに出てりゃ　つけあがりやがって

English.Text: I'm tryin' to be nice, and ya walk all over me!

Text: てめえらのほうが　よっぽど悪党じゃねえか！

English.Text:
You know what I think!?
You people are the real thieves!

Text: ゴクアクニン！

English.Text: Buncha scumbags!

Text: ヒトデナシ！

English.Text: Real full bags!

Text: ふんふん！

English.Text: Hrmph-hmph!

Text: 後悔しても知らねえからな

English.Text: Don't say I didn't try to keep it peaceful!

Text: これがベグカンパニーの最終兵器だ！

English.Text: You guys messed with the wrong legitimate businessmen!

Text: もう　カンベンしてくれ！

English.Text: C'mon, ya gotta let us off the hook!

Text: カンベン　カンベン

English.Text: Off the hook! Off the hook!

Text: ベンベン　ベンカン　ベベンべベン？

English.Text: Off the...off...hook...the...off?

Text:
オレたちはただ　お宝を売った金で
足を洗いたかっただけだ

English.Text: All we wanted was to sell the treasure for some cash so we could stop stealin' and start fresh!

Text:
カンパニーを作って
まっとうなショーバイをしたかったんだよう

English.Text: It's always been our dream to start a company and do honest work!

Text: ねえ　ちゃんと交渉しない？

English.Text: Hey, we could throw 'em a bone.

Text: ２０００で　どうだ

English.Text: Two thousand gil.

Text: おお　交渉セーリツだあ！

English.Text: Woo! Done! You guys got yourself a deal!

Text: ２０００ギル払いますか？

English.Text: Pay them 2,000 gil?

Text: 払う

English.Text: Yes

Text: やっぱりやめる

English.Text: No

Text: うん？　手持ちが足りねえぞ

English.Text: Huh? You're comin' up a little short there, pal.

Text: ふん　後悔しても知らねえからな！

English.Text: Hmph... And here I thought you wanted this thing!

Text:
おう　待ってたぜ
２０００だったよな？

English.Text: Was wonderin' how long you were gonna drag this out! Got that two thousand yet?

Text:
２０００ギルで足を洗うのか？
どうやって洗うんだ

English.Text: We're washin' our hands of the crimes? But how?

Text:
ああ　そりゃあれだ
カネで足をこするのさ

English.Text: "How?" Shit, that's easy. You take the cash and you rub it between your fingers.

Text: おお　そうか！

English.Text: Oh, I feel cleaner already!

Text:
おまえら知ってるか　大金持ちはよ
カネの風呂に入ってるんだぞ

English.Text: You think that's clean? There are folks out there so filthy-stinkin' rich that they bathe in money!

Text:
すっげえ！
でもそれ　気持ちいいのか？

English.Text: That's awesome! Maybe we should get a bathtub?

Text: う～ん……

English.Text: Hmm...

Text: ２０００ギル　まだかな？

English.Text: We still waitin' for the money?

Text:
あせんじゃねえ
ショーバイは待つことも大切だ

English.Text: Easy now. Patience is key for runnin' an upright business.

Text:
オレたち　これからは
まっとうに生きような？

English.Text: This is so great. We're gonna lead honest lives!

Text: ふんふん！

English.Text: Mm-hmm!

Text: うんうん

English.Text: So honest!

Text: まっとう！

English.Text: Honest!

Text: へへ　まいどあり～

English.Text: Haha! Pleasure doin' business!

Text: どうだおまえら　これがショーバイだ！

English.Text: See that, boys!? That's how you broker an honest deal!

Text: 盗賊　やめるんだよね

English.Text: And hey─no more bandit stuff.

Text:
おうよ　もう盗みはやらねえ
なんたってオレたちは『ベグカンパニー』だからな

English.Text: You better believe it! From now on, we're earning our money the honest way. As a business─Beck's Business, baby!

Text: カンパニー　カンパニー！

English.Text: Beck's got a business! What kinda business? Honest business!

Text:
よ～し　今日からオレはシャチョー！
おまえたちはシャインだ

English.Text: Right─let's talk corporate structure! I'm president and you're my employees! Got it?

Text:
おっ　シャインか！
シャイン　シャイン……

English.Text: Oh, I'm ployees! Burke's ployees! Wait.

Text: シャインって　なんだ？

English.Text: What's a ployee do anyway?

Text: シャインってなんだ？

English.Text: "What's a ployee do anyway?"

Text: 仲間だ

English.Text: Be a buddy.

Text: 家族だ

English.Text: Act as family.

Text: 奴隷だ

English.Text: Work as a servant.

Text:
おお　仲間か～！
みんなでカンパニーをでっかくしような

English.Text: We're buddies!? That's cool! Me and the buddies are gonna make our business real big!

Text:
そうか　家族か～！
へへへ……なんか　あったかいなあ

English.Text: Oh, family! Heh! I always wanted one of those.

Text: ドレイ？　ドレイ……

English.Text: Servants? So like...

Text: バカ　んなワケねえだろ！

English.Text: Don't be a dumbass, dumbass!

Text: てめえも　よけいなこと言うんじゃねえ！

English.Text: And you! Quit screwin' with his head!

Text: よ～し　おまえら！

English.Text: Alright, boys!

Text:
さっそく働くぞ　シャチョーについてこい
新しいお宝探しだ　イエーイ！

English.Text: We got work to do! There's glittering riches out there, and your president's gonna lead you to it! Let's business!

Text: リョーカイです　シャチョー！

English.Text: Yessir, Mr. Prez!

Text: シャチョー！

English.Text: To the prez!

Text: 更生　したのかな？

English.Text: So, you think they've turned over a new leaf?

Text: さあな

English.Text: Who knows.

Text:
こいつは　エサじゃなくて
あいつらの寝床なんだ

English.Text: This stuff here ain't feed for the animals. It's their beddin'.

Text:
ちゃんと乾かしてないと機嫌悪くてな
おいらの頭　かじってくるんだ

English.Text: When it ain't been dried enough, they get all bent outta shape─start peckin' at my head like it's a damn hay barrel!

Text:
エサは常に補充しておかないとね
まるまる太らせると　高く売れるからさ

English.Text: It's important to make sure they've got plenty to eat. Need to be nice and plump so they fetch a high price!

Text:
生まれた時からいっしょだった
相棒のチョコボが　死んじまったんだ

English.Text: Was with my bird since he was hatched. And now he's gone.

Text: いい加減　前に進まないといけないのに

English.Text: I know I gotta "get it together" and move on...

Text: なかなか　踏ん切りがつかないのさ

English.Text: ...But knowin' it and doin' it are...

Text: ほう　こんなところにお客人かな？

English.Text: Well, I'll be. Not every day we get visitors.

Text:
たまーに　ミッドガルやジュノンから
面白いガラクタが流れ着くんだ

English.Text: Every now and then some interesting junk floats in from Midgar or Junon.

Text:
昔はここでも
魚が捕れたもんだけどねえ

English.Text: We used to go fishing here, you know. Oh, the memories...

Text:
この港はもともと
ジュノン共和国が使っていたそうよ

English.Text: Apparently this port used to be bustling back in the republic days.

Text: おまたせ～　ピコの準備できたよ

English.Text: Hey, perfect timing. Piko's all prepped.

Text: じゃあ　これ

English.Text: But first─here.

Text:
この笛を吹けば
いつでもチョコボを呼び出せるから

English.Text:
You just give that whistle a toot and
your chocobo'll come a-runnin'.

Text: チョコボに乗るの　はじめての人もいるよね？

English.Text: So, who here's never been on chocoback?

Text: はいは～い！

English.Text: I haven't!

Text:
じゃあ　うちの練習場を使っていいよ
案内するね

English.Text: Why don't we take a few laps to get you comfortable, then? Come with me.

Text: こっちだよ

English.Text: This way!

Text: どこ行くの？

English.Text: Where you goin'?

Text: ここで　レースに出るチョコボを調整してるんだ

English.Text: Here's where we get our birds in shape for the races.

Text: レースって？

English.Text: What races?

Text:
ゴールドソーサーで開催されている
チョコボレースのことだよ

English.Text:
The Gold Saucer's, I mean.
They're a big deal in our community.

Text: 世界中のチョコボファームが参加するんだ

English.Text:
Won't find a ranch around here
that doesn't compete.

Text: グリン牧場も出るの？

English.Text: So you guys race too?

Text:
父さんと母さんがいなくなってからは
一度も……

English.Text: We've been sittin' it out since Mom and Dad left.

Text:
でも　近いうちに出るつもりだよ
どうしても　勝ちたい相手がいるんだ

English.Text:
But we're gonna get back in the fight soon...
and kick the tar outta one particularly nasty weasel.

Text:
お兄さんたちはレースに出るわけじゃないから
とりあえず　チョコボに振り落とされないようにね

English.Text: But never you mind all that. You just focus on the basics─like makin' sure you don't get thrown from the saddle.

Text: それじゃあ　チョコボに乗ったら声をかけて

English.Text:
Why don't you try hoppin' on Piko
and givin' me a holler?

Text:
チョコボは　笛を吹くと来てくれるよ
乗ったら声をかけてよ

English.Text: Remember now! Just give your whistle a blow to ride your chocobo!

Text: チョコボに乗らないと　練習できないよ？

English.Text: C'mon, call Piko already, will ya?

Text:
いい感じだね！
じゃあ　かるく走ってみようか

English.Text: Okay! But how's about we stretch his legs a bit?

Text: 『ダッシュ・デ・チョコボ』に挑戦しますか？

English.Text: Participate in Hustle de Chocobo?

Text: はい

English.Text: Yes

Text: いいえ

English.Text: No

Text: 準備ができたら　声をかけてよ

English.Text: I'll be here when you're ready.

Text: 走る準備はできた？

English.Text: Y'all ready to run?

Text:
すごいね！
ピコとの相性もいいみたいだし

English.Text:
That was somethin' else.
You and Piko are a perfect match.

Text:
もしかしたら　お兄さんとピコなら
レースでも勝てるかも！

English.Text: Might even have what it takes to win a race or two at the Gold Saucer!

Text:
まあ　はじめは誰でもそんなもんさ
慣れればもっと　うまく乗れるようになるよ

English.Text: Not terrible... But hey─now that you got the basics, it's just a matter of practice.

Text: いろいろ　ありがとね

English.Text: We can't thank you enough, Billy.

Text:
そういえば　お姉さんたち
お金ないんだよね？

English.Text:
Oh, that reminds me.
Y'all mentioned you're flat broke, right?

Text: カームなら　仕事があると思うよ

English.Text: Then you might wanna swing by Kalm again.

Text:
神羅の軍隊もいなくなって
落ちついたみたいだから　行ってみれば？

English.Text: Now that the troopers've cleared out, it's prob'ly safe for you to ask around for work.

Text:
そうだ　ついでに
クリンの依頼を受けてやってくれない？

English.Text:
Though don't run off just yet.
My sister's lookin' for help.

Text:
なんだか　困ってるみたいなんだけど
ぼくには話してくれないんだ

English.Text:
Not sure what the trouble is.
Didn't wanna confide in me for whatever reason.

Text:
クリン　ずっと元気がなくって
妹は　母さんが大好きだったから

English.Text: Honestly, she hasn't been herself since Mom left. They did dang near everything together.

Text: なんでも屋　してく？

English.Text: You wanna lend Chloe a hand?

Text: いや　急ぎたい

English.Text: We need to move on.

Text: 旅　お金かかるよね

English.Text: True, but moving on costs money...

Text: なんでも屋　手伝うの楽しいし　ね？

English.Text:
We had fun helping people in Sector 5, right?
Same deal!

Text: チョコボの練習していく？

English.Text: You lookin' to practice?

Text: 練習場ならあいてるよ

English.Text: Track's yours if ya need it.

Text: 走ってく？

English.Text: What's up?

Text: このタイムならレースでも通用すると思うよ

English.Text: Keep ridin' like that and you'll clean up at the races.

Text: 完璧にチョコボを乗りこなしてるね

English.Text: You're a bona fide jockey alright!

Text: もうアドバイスすることはないよ

English.Text: Got nothing left to teach you anymore.

Text: もっと練習したほうがいいね

English.Text: 'Nother lap wouldn't kill you...

Text: チョコボのことを考えて走らないと

English.Text: Gotta be in sync with your bird to do well.

Text: これがレースだったら　大恥かいてたよ

English.Text: They'd boo you right outta the Saucer for that performance.

Text: あっ　クラウドさん

English.Text: Oh, hey! You're back!

Text: なにか　困っているらしいな

English.Text: I heard you might need some help.

Text:
えっ？　ああ
お兄ちゃんから聞いたんですね

English.Text: You did? Oh, I see. Billy talked to you, didn't he?

Text:
お花をつみに行きたいんですけど
モンスターのせいで行けないんです

English.Text: I've been meaning to go pick flowers, but the plains are way too dangerous for that.

Text: そうか～　お花はガマンできないよね

English.Text:
I'm sorry to hear that.
As a flower lover myself, I sympathize.

Text: お花を集めて　これを作りたいんです

English.Text: Well, the thing is, I wanna make a flower crown.

Text: お母さんが　よく作ってくれたんです

English.Text: Mom used to make 'em for us all the time.

Text:
わたしも作りたいのに　モンスターが増えちゃって
お花のとこまで行けなくて

English.Text: So I wanted to give it a try, but...with all the monsters, I didn't know how I could.

Text: ねえ　わたしたち　つんでもいい？

English.Text:
Here's an idea: maybe we could
do the picking for you?

Text: もちろん

English.Text: Sure!

Text: クラウド　どうかな？

English.Text: Cloud? Thoughts?

Text: 依頼を引き受けますか？

English.Text: What will you say?

Text: 両親はどうしたんだ？

English.Text: What happened to your parents?

Text: サムとの関係は？

English.Text: How do you know Sam?

Text: グリングリンに頼め

English.Text: Ask your brother.

Text: 引き受けよう

English.Text: We'll take the job.

Text:
わたしが　もっと小さかった頃に
死んでしまいました

English.Text:
Truth is, our parents died in an accident
when I was really little.

Text: 事件に巻き込まれたんです

English.Text: Billy doesn't like to talk about it.

Text: そう……

English.Text: Sorry.

Text: よく家族でピクニックをしたんです

English.Text: We used to go on these family picnics.

Text:
お弁当を食べたあと
お母さんが花飾りを作ってくれて

English.Text: And after we were done eating, Mom would make flower crowns for me and Billy.

Text: すごく嬉しかったな

English.Text: I'd wear mine for days.

Text:
サムのせいで　お父さんとお母さんが死んだって
お兄ちゃんが言ってました

English.Text: I shouldn't tell you this, but he's the reason Mom and Dad died. That's what Billy says.

Text: でも　くわしいことは教えてくれないんです

English.Text: I dunno... He always changes the subject when I ask.

Text: ナイショのプレゼントにしたいんです

English.Text: I would, but it's a gift.

Text:
お母さんとお父さんがいなくなってから
ずっと　がんばってるお兄ちゃんに

English.Text:
He's had to work so hard since we're on our own.
I wanted to do something nice for him.

Text: うんうん　お兄ちゃんには頼めないね

English.Text: Of course. I promise you we'll keep it a surprise.

Text: 本当ですか！

English.Text: Really? You will?

Text: お花はミッドガルが見える丘に咲いています

English.Text:
The flowers grow on a hill that's
got a great view of Midgar.

Text: ちょっと遠いけど　チョコボに乗ればすぐです

English.Text: It's kinda far, but a chocobo'll get you there quick!

Text: よろしくお願いします

English.Text: Thank you so much!

Text: わあ　知らないお花　いっぱい！

English.Text: Wow, just look at all of them! I've never seen these kinds before!

Text: お花　選ばなくちゃね

English.Text: So, know which ones to pick?

Text: ああ……まかせる

English.Text: Yeah... I got this.

Text: その顔　あんまりよくないなあ

English.Text:
As much as I want to believe you,
your face says otherwise.

Text: ちゃんと手伝うからね

English.Text: Good thing you've got me here.

Text: リーフハウスに持ってくお花　選んだよね

English.Text:
Sorta reminds me of when we
picked flowers for the Leaf House.

Text:
わあ　いいかおり～
クラウド　引き寄せられちゃった？

English.Text: Wow, these smell heavenly! Definitely the right choice if you want something fragrant.

Text: 『白色の花』にしますか？

English.Text: Pick stalks of white daisies?

Text: 『黄色の花』にしますか？

English.Text: Pick stalks of yellow calendulas?

Text: 『赤色の花』にしますか？

English.Text: Pick stalks of red gerbera?

Text: 『青色の花』にしますか？

English.Text: Pick stalks of blue forget-me-nots?

Text: 『ねこじゃらし』にしますか？

English.Text: Pick foxtails?

Text: この花にする

English.Text: Yes.

Text: もうすこし考える

English.Text: Lemme think on it.

Text:
かわいい！
やわらかいし　花飾りに向いてるね

English.Text: So cute─and soft too. Perfect for a flower crown.

Text:
おお～　情熱的な色
クラウド　そういうの　好き？

English.Text:
Ooh, now these are vibrant.
So you like deep, passionate reds, do you?

Text: さすが　お目が高い

English.Text: Hey, that's a good find!

Text:
この子の花言葉は『家族への愛』
プレゼントにぴったり

English.Text: Those symbolize familial love. Pretty spot-on for our purposes, wouldn't you agree?

Text:
でた　ねこじゃらし！
クラウド　選ぶような気してたんだ

English.Text:
I just knew you'd go for the foxtails.
I swear, I can read you like a book.

Text: 花飾りだから　もっと必要だね

English.Text:
That's a start,
but we're definitely gonna need more.

Text: もうちょっと　つんでく？

English.Text: A few more couldn't hurt.

Text:
うん　これくらいあればじゅうぶん
クリンに届けよう

English.Text:
Alright! That should probably be enough.
Let's go give 'em to Chloe.

Text:
わあ～！
こんなにたくさん　ありがとう

English.Text: Wow! Look at all of these! Thank you!

Text: どういたしまして

English.Text: It was our pleasure.

Text: 花飾り　お母さんみたいに作れるかな

English.Text:
I'm kinda worried, though.
What if mine's not as pretty as Mom's?

Text:
わたし　じつはお花屋さんなの
花飾り　手伝おうか

English.Text: Well, lucky for you, I just so happen to be a florist! I'd be more than happy to help you put one together.

Text: ほんと？

English.Text: Really?

Text: いっしょに作ろ　ねっ　クラウド

English.Text: We'll make two. Right, Cloud?

Text: ああ

English.Text: Sure.

Text: できた

English.Text: Look!

Text: う～ん　お花の組み合わせ　独特だね

English.Text: Gosh...it's, uh...it's definitely unique! One of a kind.

Text:
でも　楽しくていいと思います
わたし　気に入りました！

English.Text: Maybe, but unique is exactly what I wanted! I love it. Thank you.

Text: できた

English.Text: Look!

Text: どう？

English.Text: You like?

Text: お母さんのと違うけど　かわいい

English.Text: It's not the same as Mom's, but yeah, I do!

Text: お姉さん　お兄さん　ありがとう

English.Text: Thank you so much, both of you.

Text: できた～！

English.Text: Look!

Text: お母さんが作ったみたい

English.Text: It's just like Mom's.

Text: クリンが作ったんだよ

English.Text: But this one's all yours.

Text:
そっか　わたしでも作れるんだ
お姉さん　お兄さん　教えてくれてありがとう！

English.Text: Yeah. I didn't think I could do it, but I did! You two are the best. I couldn't have made this without you.

Text: とにかく　やってみろ

English.Text: Yeah, you could. Believe in yourself.

Text: はい！

English.Text: Thanks!

Text: あれ　なにか問題？

English.Text: There somethin' I can help ya with?

Text: お兄ちゃん！

English.Text: Oh, Billy!

Text: お兄ちゃん　これ

English.Text: Here─for you.

Text: これ　クリンが作ったの？

English.Text: Chloe, did you make this?

Text: うん

English.Text: Uh-huh.

Text: ありがとう

English.Text: Thanks.

Text: どうかな
似合ってる　ね？

English.Text: Cute, don'tcha think?

Text: ああ

English.Text: Yeah.

Text: おそろいだ

English.Text: Cute.

Text: お兄ちゃん　喜んでくれるかな

English.Text: Billy is gonna like it...right?

Text: もちろん

English.Text: He'll love it.

Text: うれしいよね？

English.Text: Won't he?

Text: ああ

English.Text: Yeah.

Text: おそろいだ

English.Text: Cute.

Text: 妹を助けてくれて　ありがとう

English.Text: I appreciate you helpin' out Chloe.

Text: クラウドのおかげで　クリンが明るくなったよ

English.Text: Can't remember the last time I saw her smile like that.

Text: この花飾り　大切にしますね

English.Text: Honestly? I never wanna take it off.

Text: 次は　おじいちゃんの花飾りを作るつもりです

English.Text: Do you think Grandpa would like one of my flower crowns too?

Text: あっ　クラウドさん

English.Text: Oh! Hi, Cloud!

Text:
お兄ちゃんに聞きました
ピコでレースに出たんでしょ？

English.Text: Congrats on your big race with Piko! Billy told me everything.

Text:
お兄ちゃん　しばらくレースに集中するから
牧場には戻れないって

English.Text: Billy probably won't come back to the ranch for a while. He says he's gotta focus on training right now.

Text: わたしもピコのレース　見たかったな

English.Text: I really wish I could've been there to see Piko win.

Text: お兄ちゃん　無茶してなきゃいいんだけど

English.Text: I hope Billy isn't causing too much trouble.

Text:
あっ　みなさん
お兄ちゃんから連絡がありました

English.Text: Oh, you're here! Great timing─I just heard from Billy!

Text:
伝説のチョコボ仙人のところで
修行してるそうです

English.Text: He says he's in Nibel training with the chocobo sage himself!

Text:
お兄ちゃんに聞きました
海チョコボを捕まえたんでしょ？

English.Text: Billy told me about how you guys caught a chocobo that can travel on water!

Text:
お兄ちゃん　このあとゴールドカップに
挑戦するって言ってるんですけど

English.Text: Billy's talking about competing in the Gold Cup. But that's a big race...

Text: 大丈夫かな～

English.Text: Do you think he's ready?

Text: わたしもいつか　海チョコボで海を飛んでみたいな

English.Text: I bet it's a blast zooming across the water on those birds you just caught!

Text:
クラウドさん
ゴールドカップ　お疲れさまでした

English.Text: Cloud! I just wanna say congratulations on the Gold Cup!

Text:
うちみたいな小さな牧場が勝てるなんて
いまでも信じられません　夢みたいです！

English.Text: I never thought in a million years our ranch could win! It's like a dream come true! Thank you!

Text:
お父さんとお母さんのこと
お兄ちゃんから　聞きました

English.Text: Billy told me everything about Mom and Dad. What they were doing.

Text: ふたりが命がけで守ったチョコボや牧場を

English.Text: They risked their lives for the ranch and the chocobos.

Text:
今度は　わたしとお兄ちゃんで
守っていこうと思います

English.Text: So we're gonna carry on their legacy. I think they'd like that.

Text: お兄ちゃん　電話の向こうで泣いてました

English.Text: Billy started crying like a baby on the phone.

Text:
その声を聞いて
わたしも嬉しくて泣いちゃいました

English.Text: Which made me start crying too! I was just so happy for him, you know?

Text:
ゴールドカップに勝ってから
問い合わせの電話が鳴りやまないんですよ

English.Text: Our phone's been practically ringing off the hook ever since you won the Gold Cup!

Text:
クリンの花飾りづくりを
手伝ってくれたんだって？

English.Text: Heard how ya helped Chloe with that flower crown of hers. Awful sweet of ya.

Text:
両親のリングリンとチョイスに代わって
礼を言うよ

English.Text: Only wish Will and Clara were around to see it, but...they made their bed.

Text: わたし　グリンの息子がリングリン

English.Text: Oh! Apologies. Will's my son...

Text:
リングリンとチョイスの子供が
グリングリンとクリン

English.Text: Clara's his wife. Billy and Chloe're theirs, if they haven't already told ya.

Text: 覚えやすい名前だろ？

English.Text: Bill, Will, Billy.

Text: リングリンとチョイスがいなくなって

English.Text: Anyway...since Will and Clara took off...

Text:
残された子供たちのためにも
まだまだ引退なんかしておられんよ

English.Text: it's up to me to make sure Chloe and Billy are raised right. And here I was, plannin' for retirement...

Text:
おお　いらっしゃい
チョコボの具合はいかがかな？

English.Text: Why, if it ain't my favorite customers! So, how're the birds treatin' ya?

Text:
チョコボのことなら　グリン牧場におまかせあれ
まあ　詳しいことは奥にいるクリンに聞いてくれ

English.Text: Make sure 'n' stop by the shop should ya find yourself in need of provisions. Just give our Chloe a holler, and she'll see you're ready for the road.

Text:
聞いたぞ
ピコに乗ってレースに勝ったんだって？

English.Text: There he is, the man of the hour! Heard how you 'n' Piko took home first!

Text:
ひと目見た時から　やる男だとは思っていたが
やはり　わたしの見る目は正しかったな

English.Text: Always knew there was somethin' special about you, boy. From the moment I laid eyes on ya, I thought "Now that one's a winner!"

Text:
グリングリンのヤツ　調子に乗って
サムのとこと問題を起こさなきゃいいんだが

English.Text: Just hope Billy doesn't let that trophy go to his head. Kid's a fighter, but he'll need to keep his cool round Sam, or he'll wind up in a whole mess of trouble.

Text:
おお　ニブルのチョコボ仙人と会ったんだって？
あのじいさん　元気にしてたか

English.Text: Met the chocobo sage, didja? Man's an odd duck, ain't he─and that's puttin' it mildly!

Text:
まさか親子そろって
仙人のところへ押しかけるとは　血は争えんな

English.Text: Ain't that somethin', though? Billy followin' in his father's footsteps─literally! Guess it's true what they say: blood will out!

Text:
おまえさんがゴールドカップを
取ってくれたおかげで　お客がいっきに増えてな

English.Text: You winnin' the Gold Cup was the best thing that ever happened to my ranch. Got customers out the wazoo!

Text: 老体にムチ打って働いとるよ

English.Text: Which, frankly, is murder on these old bones.

Text:
グリングリンには　これを機に
グリン牧場の名前をしっかりと広めてもらわんとな

English.Text: Fortunately for me, I got a young whippersnapper in Billy, and he's ready to put in the work─make sure your victory don't go to waste!

Text:
両親の意志を引き継いだ孫たちが
どう育っていくのか　いまから楽しみだよ

English.Text: I see so much of Will and Clara in Billy and Chloe... Their drive, ambition─their work ethic. Lookin' forward to seein' the people they become.

Text: こんにちは　チョコボ車をご利用ですか？

English.Text: Howdy! Our carriages'll get you where you need to go!

Text:
私　いつもは近くの農場で働いてるんですけど
ときどきグリン牧場のお手伝いをしてるんです

English.Text: Well, I say "our," but...I'm not a regular employee. I only fill in from time to time, whenever the farm I work isn't busy.

Text: チョコボ車でおでかけですか？

English.Text: Spare your legs and catch a ride!

Text: どちらに行かれます？

English.Text: Where ya headed to today?

Text: す～は～　草のいいニオイ～

English.Text: Just smell that fresh air... Sure beats the city!

Text: いつでもどうぞ～

English.Text: Come back anytime!

Text: また遊びにきてくださいね

English.Text: We'll be here whenever you need a lift!

Text: 草原に寝転ぶのって最高ですよね

English.Text: Don't you just love the wide open plains and sun on your face?

Text: いらっしゃい

English.Text: Welcome!

Text: お客さん　新顔だね

English.Text: New around here, I take it?

Text: 今日は特別営業中だ　１杯どうだい？

English.Text:
Want a drink?
Little early, but we got an excuse...

Text:
ミッドガルの騒ぎで
ひと儲けさせてもらってるよ

English.Text: Hate to say it, but the mess in Midgar's been good for business.

Text: いらっしゃい……

English.Text: Hey, how you doin'...

Text: なんだ

English.Text: What?

Text: お客さん　デキる人だな？

English.Text:
Hey, mister...
You a winner?

Text: たいていはな

English.Text: Some say.

Text: おお　すばらしい！

English.Text: Awesome! That's good enough for me!

Text:
俺はヴァル
ぜひ頼みたいことがあるんだ

English.Text: The name's Vash, and I could really use your help.

Text: 君たち　クイーンズ・ブラッドは知ってるだろ？

English.Text: Truth is, I bungled a Queen's Blood match─hard.

Text:
実は　カードバウトに負けて
大切なカードを奪われてしまってね

English.Text: So, not only did my ego take a lickin'...but I lost a card near and dear to my heart.

Text: そのカードを　なんとか取り返してきてくれないか

English.Text:
What I'm gettin' at is...
think ya'd be able to win it back for me?

Text: 依頼を引き受けますか？

English.Text: What will you say?

Text: どういうカードだ？

English.Text: What card is it?

Text: 自分で取り返せ

English.Text: Get it back yourself.

Text: 引き受けよう

English.Text: We'll take the job.

Text:
『チョコボ＆モーグリ』
俺が持っていた唯一のレアカードだったんだ

English.Text: The chocobo and moogle one. It's rare, and the one high-value card in my whole deck.

Text:
酔っ払いにからまれても　酒が薄いってクレームも
レアカードを持ってたから耐えられたんだ

English.Text: It was the only thing gettin' me through the daily grind. I mean, the bullshit I have to put up with at this job! The fights, the late nights, the drunks!

Text: それをあいつが……

English.Text:
And that slimy bastard...
He... He stole it!

Text:
気持ち　わかります
私もバーテンダーだから

English.Text: Hey, I get it... I'm a bartender too.

Text:
へえ　そうなんだ
ほんと　いろいろ大変だよな

English.Text:
You...you are?
So then you know just how tough it can be.

Text:
それができないから頼んでるんだろ！
自慢じゃないけど　俺は弱いんだ

English.Text: Don't you think I would if I could!? God, I'm a shit player! Don't you get that!?

Text: そうか……

English.Text: Whatever you say...

Text:
『クイーンズ・ブラッド』のレアカードは
高値で取引されてるんだ

English.Text:
Hardcore players're willing to throw down
hella gil for rare cards!

Text:
ああ　はやく取り戻さないと
売られてしまうかも
