English.Text: Please, I'm begging you, you've gotta get it back before that asshole tries to sell it!

Text: 本当か　助かるよ！

English.Text: Oh, thank you. Thank you!

Text:
そうだ　依頼する前にいちおう
君の腕前を確かめさせてもらっていいかな

English.Text: But first, I gotta make sure I'm puttin' my baby's fate in the right hands. Mind if we go a round?

Text: カードバウトの準備ができたら　声をかけてくれ

English.Text: Just lemme know when you're ready to play. I'll be here.

Text:
それじゃあ『チョコボ＆モーグリ』を取り戻せるか
カードバウトの腕を見させてもらうよ

English.Text: Alright! Ready to prove you got what it takes to beat that jerk and win back my Chocobo & Moogle card?

Text: カードバウトしていくかい？

English.Text: How's about a match?

Text: バウトするかい？

English.Text: Feelin' the call of the cards?

Text: やる気になったら　また声をかけてくれ

English.Text: Gimme a holler when you're ready to throw down.

Text:
おいおい　俺に負けるようじゃ依頼できないよ
もうすこし腕を磨いてきてくれ

English.Text: Hoo boy. You lost against me? No way you're gonna be able to win my card back! Gotta do better if you want the job.

Text:
うん　いい腕だ
これなら申し分ない

English.Text:
Okay! That's the kinda skill I'm talkin' about!
You'll beat Virgil no prob!

Text:
カードを奪ったのは
塔の係員をやってるビルゴってやつだ

English.Text: That's the guy you gotta play, the one who took my card. He works at the clock tower.

Text: かたき討ち　頼んだぞ

English.Text: Mind kickin' his ass for me?

Text:
そうだ　カードを取り戻してくれたら
とっておきのカクテルを　ごちそうするよ

English.Text: And when you're done, come straight back. I'll have a special cocktail waiting with your name on it.

Text: すこし前に　いいレシピを手に入れてね

English.Text: Got this great recipe I've been itchin' to try again!

Text: まさか勝てるとは　自分でもビックリだ

English.Text: Holy shit, I won? Well I'll be!

Text: ちょっと　自信がついてきたな

English.Text: Maybe I do have some skills...

Text:
ふん　俺に勝ったからって
自慢にならないぜ

English.Text: Yeah, yeah. You won, I lost. Big frickin' deal.

Text: どうやったら勝てるんだ

English.Text: Damn, am I ever gonna win a match...?

Text:
塔の上から
美しい草原を眺めてみませんか？

English.Text: You'll find there's no finer view of the plains than from our clock tower.

Text: 塔からの絶景をお楽しみください

English.Text: The climb is worth it, I promise.

Text: 酒場のマスターから奪ったカードを返してくれ

English.Text: We're here for the card you took from the bartender.

Text: へえ　なるほど

English.Text: Ah...the card.

Text:
ヴァルのやつ　自分では勝てないからって
刺客を送り込んできたワケですね

English.Text:
So Vash's resorted to this?
Hiring people to win his games for him?

Text:
ふふん　いいですよ
僕に勝てたら　返してあげますよ

English.Text:
Fine. But word of warning:
I'm not a pushover like some folks.

Text: いつでも相手になりますよ

English.Text: Gettin' cold feet, huh?

Text:
マスターの代理戦ですね
いいですよ　やりましょう

English.Text: This one's for ol' Vash, yeah? Well...let's hope you put up a better fight than he did.

Text: 勝負しますか？

English.Text: Oh, care for a match?

Text: 受けて立ちますよ

English.Text: Good by me.

Text:
ふっふっふ
再戦はいつでも受け付けてますよ

English.Text: Heh heh heh... You're free to try again if you're so inclined.

Text: あちゃ～　負けてしまいました

English.Text: Aw, damn... I really lost?

Text:
なかなか熱い勝負でしたね　くやしいなあ
またリベンジさせてくださいね

English.Text: It was one helluva match, though, am I right? You and I're definitely gonna have to play again sometime!

Text: えっと　じゃあ今日はこのへんで

English.Text:
But uh, not today.
Gotta run!

Text: ストップ　なにか忘れてない？

English.Text: Hold it. Aren't we forgetting something?

Text: あっはは　ですよね～

English.Text: Right, the card!

Text:
ヴァルから奪ったカードでしたっけ
えっと　どれだったかなあ

English.Text:
The one I won off Vash, right?
Uh, shoot... Which card was that again?

Text:
あっ　ヴァルのカードって
『チョコボ＆モーグリ』か……

English.Text: Ah crap. I remember. The chocobo and moogle one.

Text:
すいません　そのカード
もう手放してました

English.Text:
So, this is kinda awkward, but...
I don't have it anymore.

Text: 俺が探そう

English.Text: Is that so?

Text: いやいや　ホントですって

English.Text: No, seriously! I-I flipped it!

Text:
ちょうど　金欠だったんで
カードコレクターに売っちゃったんです

English.Text:
I was on my last gil,
so I had to sell it to a card collector.

Text:
街の外で　カードショップをやってる
トゥロンって男です

English.Text:
A guy named Thorin.
He runs this card shop outside of town.

Text: 訪ねてみてくださいよ

English.Text: Maybe check with him?

Text: もうひとがんばりだね　なんでも屋さん

English.Text: A merc's job is never done, am I right?

Text: リベンジ　お待ちしてますね

English.Text: Hope to play you again soon.

Text: ナイスバウトでした

English.Text: Not half bad!

Text: 負けてしまいました　さすがです

English.Text: You're full of surprises, aren't you?

Text: 戦術を見直したほうがいいかもな

English.Text: Might be time to rethink my strategy...

Text: いらっしゃい　カードの取引かい？

English.Text: Hey there. You folks buyin' or sellin'?

Text: 『チョコボ＆モーグリ』のカードが欲しい

English.Text: We're here for the Chocobo & Moogle card.

Text:
ああ　すまない
そのカードは販売してないんだ

English.Text:
'Course ya are. Hate to break it to ya,
but ain't no way I'm givin' up that beaut.

Text:
レアカードは　それ相応の実力者に
持ってもらいたくてね

English.Text:
At least, not to some dabbler
who fancies himself a collector.

Text: だから　そうだな

English.Text: Unless you more than dabble.

Text:
もしカードバウトで私に勝てれば
無償で進呈しよう

English.Text:
Tell you what.
You beat me, and that card is all yours.

Text: さあ　どうする？

English.Text: So, you game?

Text: 用件はなんですか？

English.Text: What will you do?

Text: クイーンズ・ブラッドについて聞く

English.Text: Ask what Queen's Blood is.

Text: <button=quest>カードバウトを申し込む

English.Text: <button=quest> Challenge him to a game.

Text: カードバウトを申し込む

English.Text: Challenge him to a game.

Text: カードを購入する

English.Text: Purchase cards.

Text: 用はない

English.Text: Leave.

Text: いま世界中で流行っているカードゲームさ

English.Text:
Why, only the most popular
card game in recent memory.

Text:
かつての世界を支配していた女王が
民衆の手によって処刑された

English.Text: Name comes from that legend of the queen who ruled the world till she was deposed and killed by her people.

Text:
そのとき流れた女王の血からモンスターが
生まれたって伝承が　名前の由来

English.Text: And from that royal blood spilt, sprouted the fiends of the world... C'mon, you know the story.

Text:
各地にプレイヤーがいて　どこかしらで
カードバウトを繰り広げているよ

English.Text: At any rate, game's really taken off. No matter where you go, you'll find people willin' to play.

Text: ふふ　そうこなくては

English.Text: Then bust out those cards, boy.

Text: バウトは　いつでも大歓迎だよ

English.Text: If you want a challenge, I'll be here.

Text: また　いつでもどうぞ

English.Text: Thank you for your patronage.

Text: よいカードと出会えますように

English.Text: If you got the gil, I got the cards.

Text:
『チョコボ＆モーグリ』が欲しければ
カードバウトに勝って　つかみとるんだね

English.Text: Only one way to get that Chocobo & Moogle card back─beat me, fair and square.

Text: クイーンズ・ブラッドの調子はどうだい？

English.Text: Hey. You been working on your deck at all?

Text: 今日はどういったご用で？

English.Text: So, what can I do for you today?

Text:
筋は悪くない
鍛え直して　また挑戦するんだね

English.Text: Y'know, you're pretty good. Not good enough, obviously, but with some practice...

Text: なるほど　君の力を見くびっていたようだ

English.Text:
You've got some serious skills, son.
Joke's on me for thinkin' otherwise.

Text: これは約束のカードだ

English.Text: Deal's a deal. Here's your card.

Text: 次やるときは　本気で戦わせてもらうよ

English.Text:
But next time you go up against me,
I'll be bringin' my A game.

Text: カードの声に耳を傾けてみるといい

English.Text: The cards have a voice, and you gotta heed their wisdom.

Text: いい刺激になった　感謝するよ

English.Text: A solid match all around. Thanks for that.

Text: いいカードをそろえているな

English.Text: That's some kinda deck you've built, son...

Text:
プレイヤー道は君にまかせて
私はコレクター道を極めることにするよ

English.Text: Right. Best I leave the playin' to you, and you leave the collectin' to me. Sound good?

Text: おお　取り戻してくれたか

English.Text: You did it! You got my baby back!

Text: 実は　こういうことは初めてじゃなくてね

English.Text: To be honest, this isn't the first card I've lost.

Text:
思うに　俺の実力じゃあ
このカード　不相応なんだろうな

English.Text:
And considering just how many I've lost,
one this rare is definitely wasted on me.

Text: なあ　君が使ってくれないか

English.Text:
Here...
It's prob'ly better off with you.

Text: いいのか？

English.Text: Really...?

Text: 強くなったら　自力で取り戻すさ

English.Text: But only until I've gotten good enough to win it back!

Text: はあ～　スッキリした

English.Text: Whew... That's a weight off my mind.

Text:
よし　おふたりさん
１杯おごらせてくれ

English.Text:
Right, enough of that!
How 'bout I fix you two your drinks?

Text:
ほら　ミッドガルの七番街で事件があったろ？
それで　引っ越してきたヤツがいてね

English.Text:
So this guy moved here recently from Midgar.
Left after the Sector 7 tragedy─you know how it is.

Text:
そいつが　スラムで飲んだカクテルが
忘れられないって言うんで　再現してみたんだ

English.Text: Anyway, he kept raving about this incredible cocktail served at a famous bar in the undercity.

Text:
『セブンスヘブン』っていう店なんだけど
知ってる？

English.Text: Seventh Heaven─dunno if you've heard of the joint.

Text: 『コスモキャニオン』　きれいな色だろ

English.Text:
They called it the "Cosmo Canyon."
Pretty, don'tcha think?

Text: さあ　どうぞ

English.Text: Go on. Drink up.

Text: いただきます

English.Text: Thanks.

Text: ごちそうさま　おいしかったです

English.Text: You know... That was just what I needed.

Text: だろ？

English.Text: Knew you'd like it!

Text:
でも　オリジナルのコスモキャニオンは
もっとうまかったらしい

English.Text: Although apparently, my version "pales in comparison" to the undercity original.

Text: 残念ながら　もう飲めないみたいだけどな

English.Text: So much so, the guy flat out refuses to order it again.

Text:
もしかしたら
岩塩をひとつまみ　加えるといいかも

English.Text:
Pinch of salt.
That'll give it the kick it needs─trust me.

Text:
なるほど　岩塩か
なるほどなあ

English.Text:
Salt, huh? Hey, that's pretty clever!
Yeah, maybe I'll try that.

Text:
えっ　もしかしてあんたが考案者？
セブンスヘブンの　七番街スラムの

English.Text: Wait. Don't tell me... You're the one who invented the Cosmo Canyon, aren't you!? You're that Seventh Heaven bartender!

Text: セブンスヘブンは　きっと再開します

English.Text: Not today, but someday soon.

Text:
その時は　遊びに来てくださいね
ごちそうしますから

English.Text:
When we do open up a new place, swing by.
I'll make you a Cosmo Canyon myself.

Text:
ああ　そりゃ楽しみだなあ
絶対行くから頑張れよ　応援するよ

English.Text: Okay, but I'm holding you to that! I'll be there opening night─with bells on! Promise!

Text:
『チョコボ＆モーグリ』は　君に託したよ
ぞんぶんに使ってやってくれ

English.Text: Make sure my Chocobo & Moogle card gets its day in the sun, alright? Don't let it go to waste.

Text: しかし　カクテルの考案者に会えるとはね

English.Text: Still can't believe it. I met the Seventh Heaven bartender!

Text:
まあ　冷や汗もんだったけど
これで　本家公認ってことだよな

English.Text: Close call with that card─nearly lost it forever. Least it's in good hands now.

Text:
ウータイの放送があってから　客足が増えたよ
みんな不安なんだろうな

English.Text: Town's on edge after Wutai's announcement, so everyone's doing what they can to keep themselves occupied.

Text: 気をまぎらわせるなら　酒とカードバウトだよな

English.Text: And what better way to forget your fears than drinking and gaming?

Text:
知ってます？　有事の際は
この塔も　見張り塔として活用されるんですよ

English.Text: Our clock tower was designed to double as an observation post in wartime, and has functioned as such in the past.

Text:
避難マニュアルの見直しをすることになって
最近　カードデッキをいじれてないんですよね

English.Text: I've been so busy trying to memorize the town's evacuation procedures, I haven't had time to reorganize my deck...

Text:
クイーンズ・ブラッドの起源は
かつて実際にあった戦争だという説もある

English.Text: There's a theory that Queen's Blood's actual origins can be traced back to an ancient war.

Text: 現実が　カードの世界のようにならなければいいが

English.Text: And here we are again, on the brink of a fresh one.

Text:
戦争にそなえてなのか
カードを手放す客が増えていてね

English.Text: Lotta folks been comin' in lately to unload their cards, now that war's in the offing.

Text: 同志としては　すこし寂しいよ

English.Text: Guess people don't got time for games no more...

Text: みなさん　どうか落ち着いて！

English.Text: Everyone, please! One at a time!

Text:
修理を手配中ですから
もうしばらくの辛抱です

English.Text: We are working as hard as we can to get the power grid back online!

Text: ああ　修理の方々――

English.Text: I was starting to worry!

Text: ……じゃないですね　失礼

English.Text:
I thought you were here to fix the─
Never mind.

Text: おう　修理よりはぶっ壊すのが得意だな

English.Text:
Yeah, we're more like "demolition experts,"
so unless you want us to blow somethin' up...

Text: こんな時です　そういう冗談は感心しませんな

English.Text:
How can you make jokes at a time like this?
It's downright distasteful.

Text: で　なんかあったのか？

English.Text: Anyway, what's goin' on?

Text: パイプから　魔晄が漏れているようです

English.Text: It's the mako pipeline. It's sprung a leak.

Text:
なんでも屋さんが応急修理をしてくれていますが
やっぱり　本職の修理じゃないと不安ですからね

English.Text:
I paid a wandering merc to patch the thing up.
I certainly wasn't about to fiddle with critical infrastructure as a layman.

Text: こうして到着を　お待ちしているわけです

English.Text: Though I thought I'd hear back from them by now...

Text: なんでも屋？

English.Text: A "merc"?

Text:
ええ　ミッドガルのスラム界隈では
有名なんだとか

English.Text:
Yep! Some hotshot from Midgar's undercity...
or so they claimed.

Text: そりゃあ　会ってみてえなあ

English.Text: Sounds like a pro we oughta get to know.

Text: では　ご紹介しましょう

English.Text: Oh, you'd like to meet them?

Text:
その代わりと言うわけではありませんが
伝言をお願いしてもいいですか？

English.Text: Well, if you're that keen, would you mind delivering a message for me while you're at it?

Text: 依頼を引き受けますか？

English.Text: What will you do?

Text: パイプとは？

English.Text: Inquire about the pipeline.

Text: なんでも屋とは？

English.Text: Ask about this "merc."

Text: 引き受けよう

English.Text: Take the job.

Text: いわゆる　魔晄パイプですな

English.Text: It's your standard mako pipeline, really.

Text:
ミッドガルからパイプを引き
魔晄を送ってもらっているのですが

English.Text: Carries a portion of Midgar's yield straight to us. We'd be lost without it.

Text: そのパイプが不調で　魔晄が来ないのです

English.Text: Hence my anxiety. We need it fixed, ASAP.

Text: タンクに貯えがあるものの　どれぐらい持つか

English.Text:
Our tank's got some left, but we'll
soon be running on fumes.

Text:
徐々に減っていく魔晄を
ビクビクしながら確認する日々です

English.Text: Makes me sick to my stomach to watch our supply slowly dwindle like this.

Text: そりゃ大変だ

English.Text: That's rough, man.

Text:
でもよ　いっそ
魔晄ナシで生活すりゃいいじゃねえか

English.Text:
But hey! Good opportunity to
wean yourselves off that poison.

Text: あっははは　またご冗談を

English.Text: Okay, now that one was funny.

Text:
この街の設備保守担当が
モンスターに襲われて　入院中なんです

English.Text: Our town technician's laid up in bed at the moment─recovering from a fiend attack.

Text:
神羅本社に応援を要請したのですが
いまはミッドガルが大変でしょう

English.Text: We asked Shinra to send someone to fill in─anyone who knows the work─but we haven't heard back.

Text:
そこに現れたのが　なんでも屋さんです
本当に助かりましたよ

English.Text: Fortunately for us, that mercenary rolled into town. Without 'em, we would've been up a creek!

Text: おお　助かります

English.Text: You will? Capital!

Text:
申し遅れましたが　わたくし
町長の　フラット・ベレージと言います

English.Text:
Oh, I haven't introduced myself yet.
I'm Fritz Bellenger, the mayor here.

Text:
なんでも屋さんは
街の外にある工房で作業中のはずです

English.Text: I'm sure that mercenary is hard at work over at the warehouse outside of town.

Text:
私からの伝言は
『状況と進捗の報告をお願いします』です

English.Text: Mind asking them to give us an update on the repairs? A simple "it's coming along" would suffice.

Text:
神羅の技術者さん　いつ来てくれますかねえ
ミッドガルが最優先でしょうからねえ

English.Text: I understand the company has their hands full right now─that Midgar's their top priority, but I hope they haven't forgotten about us.

Text: 魔晄タンクの残量が心配で　夜も眠れません

English.Text: I'm losing sleep at the thought of our mako supply running out...

Text:
なんでも屋がほかにいたとしても
スラムで有名ったら　おまえじゃねえのか

English.Text: Mercs ain't rare, but I think you're the only one who's made a name for themselves in the undercity...

Text: スラムは　あんたのほうが詳しいだろう

English.Text: So you don't know who he was talking about?

Text: なんでも屋ねえ……

English.Text: Nope. Not a clue.

Text: やっぱり　おまえしか知らねえな

English.Text: You're the only "hotshot" I know.

Text:
ほかのヤツなら
もちっと気の利いた看板あげるだろうしよ

English.Text: Most undercity mercs don't go braggin' about bein' ex-SOLDIER.

Text: 工房って　これか？

English.Text: This the warehouse the mayor was talkin' about?

Text: ああ？　誰もいねえじゃねえか

English.Text: Huh... Place looks fresh outta mercs to me.

Text: 俺になにか用か

English.Text: Did someone say "merc"?

Text: おまえ！

English.Text: I know you!

Text:
アバランチのガセネタをわめいてた
ガキじゃねえか

English.Text:
You're that Sector 5 chick who was
shittin' on Avalanche!

Text:
えっうそ　クラウド！
ここも縄張りなの？

English.Text:
Wha─ Is that Cloud?
But I was sure this wasn't your turf!

Text: パイプ修理を引き受けたなんでも屋は　おまえか

English.Text: Don't tell me─you're the merc the mayor hired?

Text: なんでも屋のキリエだ　報酬は安くない

English.Text: "Kyrie doesn't work for free─or cheap."

Text: おまえら　商売に向いてねえなあ

English.Text: How either of you get any work is a mystery to me.

Text: 町長から伝言だ　進捗を報告しろってよ

English.Text:
We're here on behalf of the mayor.
Man wants a progress report.

Text: そうだよね　そりゃそうだよね

English.Text: Yes, progress is...what I've been making.

Text: わたしも　報告したい気持ちは人一倍あるけど……

English.Text:
And I'm just dying to tell him all about it.
But the thing is...

Text: 補修に必要な部品が足りなくて　まだ全然

English.Text:
I haven't actually, like, done anything?
I need more parts.

Text: いっしょに　部品を集めてくれない？

English.Text: Wouldn't it be fun if we looked for 'em together?

Text: ふざけるな

English.Text: Hell no.

Text:
前途有望な後輩を助けると思って　ね？
なんでも言うこと聞くから

English.Text: I could really use a guiding hand from a vet in the industry─like you! I swear, I'll do anything!

Text: なんでも？

English.Text: "Anything"?

Text: なんでも屋を名乗るのをやめろ　それが条件だ

English.Text:
Fine. I'll help...
if you stop calling yourself a "merc."

Text:
交渉成立！　さっそくだけど
これが最低限必要な部品

English.Text:
You, sir, have a deal!
Okay─so these are the parts that I need.

Text:
本当は　もっと欲しいところだけど
ぜいたくは言うまい

English.Text:
More'd probably be better,
but that number there's the bare minimum.

Text: そろったら　持ってきて

English.Text: So! Any questions?

Text: 依頼を引き受けますか？

English.Text: Any questions?

Text: 部品はどこにある？

English.Text: Where are the parts?

Text: 引き受けよう

English.Text: Nope, let's do this.

Text: この先のパイプのスクラップ置き場にあると思うな

English.Text:
You can prob'ly find 'em in
scrap heaps somewhere nearby?

Text: ある　きっとある！

English.Text: I mean, I know you can!

Text: じゃあ　よろしくね～！

English.Text: Sweet! See ya soon!

Text: いっしょに探すんじゃねえのか

English.Text: I thought you were comin' with us.

Text:
わたしはここで　ほら
細かいネジとか探さないと

English.Text:
No, I need to stay here and...
look for...screws...and bolts!

Text: 部品集め　よろしくね～！

English.Text: I believe in you, fellow merc!

Text: なんでも屋って　思ってたより大変だねえ

English.Text:
Being a merc's hard.
People don't talk about that enough.

Text: はやく集めないと　日が暮れちゃう！

English.Text:
Please hurry.
I don't wanna be out here after dark.

Text: 部品　そろった？

English.Text: Didja find what we need?

Text: 集めた部品を渡しますか？

English.Text: What will you do?

Text: 持ってるだけ渡す

English.Text: Give her everything you collected.

Text: 部品について聞く

English.Text: Ask about the parts.

Text: 渡さない

English.Text: Hold on to them for now.

Text: 足りないな～

English.Text: This isn't gonna cut it.

Text: えっと足りないんですけど

English.Text: You forget how to count, or...?

Text: ああ　うんまあ　ギリギリ最低限だね

English.Text: I mean... It's not not enough? C-plus effort.

Text:
もうちょっと集めてくれると思ったけど
まあ　わたしの魅力がその程度ってことか

English.Text: Always pictured you as a "Gotta do the extra credit!" kinda guy... I misjudged you─but y'know what? That's on me.

Text:
そろってる　そろってる！
ちょっと多めに集めてくれたんだ

English.Text: Wow, look at all this! You guys went above and beyond! You get an official Kyrie Gold Star!

Text: さっすが評判のなんでも屋　なっるほど～

English.Text: And for your information, I don't give those to just anyone!

Text: わお　こんなにたくさん！

English.Text: Holy mother of scrap metal!

Text:
これだけあれば　本職みたいに直せそう
報酬も割り増しで請求できるかも？

English.Text: Way to go, guys! When we're finished, that pipe'll be good as new! I bet we could even charge extra.

Text: よ～し　じゃあついてきて

English.Text: Now then! Follow me, would you?

Text: 魔晄パイプの修理へ　レッツ・ゴー！

English.Text: Let's not keep my money─I mean the pipe─waiting!

Text:
実はわたし　家出中なんだよね
おばあちゃんとケンカしちゃって

English.Text: Grandma didn't send you out here to find me, did she? 'Cause if she did, I'm not going back!

Text:
いつまでも子供扱いで
仕事をまかせてくれなくて

English.Text: I'm sick of her treating me like a little kid, never letting me join her on a job.

Text: 頭にきて　飛びだしちゃった

English.Text: So I packed up and hit the road.

Text:
だからね　ミッドガルの外でしっかり稼いで
おばあちゃんを見返してやるの

English.Text: Now I'm out here, makin' my fortune! I can't wait to rub my success in her smug face.

Text: どこ行くの？

English.Text: Hello?

Text: こっちだよ

English.Text: It's this way!

Text: なんでも屋さん　やっちゃって！

English.Text: Fellow merc! Defend me!

Text: おそうじ　お願いね！

English.Text: Time to take out the trash!

Text: さあ　こっちこっち

English.Text: Okay! Shall we?

Text: 行きますよ～

English.Text: Let's get going!

Text: とうちゃ～く！

English.Text: Well, here we are!

Text: ちゃんと修理できんだろうな

English.Text: And you're sure that you can fix this?

Text:
スラム育ちをナメないでよね
ジャンクパーツの扱いはまかせてよ

English.Text:
You shouldn't underestimate an undercity girl!
I can spin garbage into gold─and will!

Text: なんだ！

English.Text: Company!

Text: こっちはまかせろ

English.Text: Stay back.

Text: かっこい～い！

English.Text: Yes, sir!

Text: なんだってんだよったく

English.Text: Damn, that was a tough bastard.

Text: 漏れた魔晄の影響だろう

English.Text: Mako probably mutated 'em.

Text: 物知り～！

English.Text: Look at mister know-it-all.

Text:
よ～し　かんせ～い！
これでバッチリ　報酬もガッポリ

English.Text: Okay, that oughta do it! Mission accomplished, and my reward secured.

Text:
なんでも屋同盟の結成を祝して
おつかれさまのカンパイでもする？

English.Text:
Let's go and grab a drink─celebrate
the birth of our great Mercenary Union!

Text: 約束を忘れたのか

English.Text: Forget our deal already?

Text:
なんでも屋同士
手を取り合ってがんばろ～って約束？

English.Text: C'mon, fellow merc! With my brains and your brawn, we could clean up!

Text: なんでも屋を名乗るのは　やめろ

English.Text: I'm not your "fellow" anything.

Text:
え～いいじゃん　減るもんじゃないし
宣伝してあげるからさあ

English.Text:
Oh, stop being such a tight-ass.
The point is I can help you! I can talk you up!

Text: 営業妨害だ

English.Text: Please don't.

Text: ぐぬぬぬ……あっ！

English.Text: Ugh! ...Huh?

Text:
じゃあ　なんでも屋さん
あと片付け　よろしく～！

English.Text:
Welp, since you're the only merc in town,
guess this one's all yours!

Text: コラ　待ちやがれ！

English.Text: Hey! Get back here!

Text: あのガキ　どうするよ

English.Text: What're we gonna do about the kid?

Text:
修理は完了したらしい
町長に報告して終わろう

English.Text:
Nothing. Forget her.
Repairs're done, let's go see Fritz.

Text:
おお　みなさん
なんでも屋さんに聞きましたよ

English.Text:
There you are!
I heard everything from the merc herself.

Text:
みなさんも　修理を手伝ってくださったとか
おかげさまで魔晄の供給が再開しました

English.Text: She told me how you helped with the pipeline repairs. And sure enough, thanks to you, the mako is flowing again!

Text: ありがとうございます

English.Text: We're in your debt.

Text: そのなんでも屋は　どこだ？

English.Text: Where's your merc now?

Text: 次の仕事があるとかで　慌てて出ていかれました

English.Text:
I'm not sure. She left just as soon as I paid─
for another job, perhaps?

Text:
さすが　噂にたがわぬ実力者
大忙しですなあ

English.Text:
Guess that's what fame buys you!
Plenty of work and never enough time in between!

Text: 思わぬ商売ガタキの登場だな

English.Text: Sounds like you still got competition, merc.

Text:
そうだ　心優しいなんでも屋さんから
みなさんの分の報酬を預かっております

English.Text:
Before you run off, she set this aside for you─
insisted that her fellow mercs be compensated.

Text:
魔晄タンクに魔晄が溜まっていると
安心しますな

English.Text: It's such a relief to no longer be literally scraping the bottom of the barrel.

Text: 今夜は　ぐっすり眠れそうです

English.Text: Maybe I'll finally get a restful sleep tonight.

Text:
からっぽの魔晄タンクを想像するだけで
足が震えます

English.Text: Just thinking about our poor town running out of mako gives me palpitations.

Text:
魔晄タンク　見晴らし塔　堅牢な外壁
カームならではの光景はいかがですかな？

English.Text: Kalm has a lot to offer tourists, you know. Our mako tank, the views from the clock tower, our one-of-a-kind bailey...

Text:
ミッドガルの喧騒に疲れた方には
カームの穏やかな生活がオススメです

English.Text: Our quiet town is the perfect getaway for all those looking to escape that urban circus of Midgar.

Text: どうです　移住されませんか？

English.Text: Ever consider moving out here and joining us?

Text:
ウータイの映像　ご覧になられましたか
あいつら魔晄欲しさに　戦争をしかける気ですよ

English.Text: Did you see that Wutai broadcast? I'm telling you, they're just jealous of our mako! Why else would they go to war?

Text:
たとえウータイと戦争になったとしても
わが町は堅牢な壁に守られているので　安心ですな

English.Text: Don't you worry! If Wutai does decide to invade, Kalm's famous bailey'll keep our residents safe and sound, mark my words!

Text:
万がいちに備えて
カームでは　防災訓練を計画中です

English.Text: Though I'm sure it won't come to it, we're setting up evacuation routes just in case.

Text: ああ　修理の方々――

English.Text: I was starting to worry!

Text: ……じゃないですね　失礼

English.Text: Oh, I thought you were here to fix the... Never mind.

Text: おう　修理よりはぶっ壊すのが得意だな

English.Text: Yeah, we're more like "demolition experts," so unless you want us to blow somethin' up...

Text: こんな時です　そういう冗談は感心しませんな

English.Text: How can you make jokes at a time like this? It's downright distasteful.

Text: で　なんかあったのか？

English.Text: Anyway, what's goin' on?

Text: パイプから　魔晄が漏れているようです

English.Text: It's the mako pipeline. It's sprung a leak.

Text:
なんでも屋さんに　応急処置を依頼したのですが
逃げてしまったようで

English.Text: I paid a wandering merc to repair the thing, but then she up and ran off with our money!

Text: なんでも屋？

English.Text: A "merc"?

Text:
ええ　可愛らしい感じの娘さんで
腕前は　ミッドガルで評判なのだとか

English.Text: Some hotshot from Midgar's undercity. She'd made quite a name for herself there. Or so she claimed...

Text: すっかり　信じてしまったのですが

English.Text: I bought it hook line and sinker...

Text:
もしや　お知り合いで？
でしたら　これもご縁です

English.Text:
You don't know the merc, do you?
Regardless, we still need help, so...

Text: 修理をお願いできませんか

English.Text: Perhaps you could do the repairs?

Text: 依頼を引き受けますか？

English.Text: Could you do the repairs instead?

Text: パイプとは？

English.Text: What's this about a mako pipeline?

Text: 修理工はいないのか？

English.Text: Can't hire a technician?

Text: 引き受けよう

English.Text: Yeah, I'll do them.

Text:
街の設備保守担当は
モンスターに襲われて　入院中なんです

English.Text: Our town technician's laid up in bed at the moment, recovering from a fiend attack.

Text:
神羅本社に応援を要請したのですが
いまはミッドガルが大変でしょう

English.Text: We asked Shinra to send someone to fill in─anyone who knows the work─but we haven't heard back.

Text: 待ってはいるのですが　いつになることやら

English.Text: I understand Midgar takes priority, but still...

Text: おお　助かります

English.Text: You will? Capital!

Text:
申し遅れましたが　わたくし
町長の　フラット・ベレージと言います

English.Text: Oh, haven't introduced myself yet! I'm Fritz Bellenger, mayor of Kalm.

Text: では　街の外にある工房へ向かってください

English.Text: I sent that no-good merc to the warehouse outside of town.

Text:
なんでも屋さんが放り出した仕事の
引き継ぎをお願いします

English.Text: Head there first and finish what I hope she at least started...

Text:
ああ　みなさん
いいところにいらっしゃった

English.Text:
Oh, there you are!
Excellent timing.

Text:
実は　魔晄パイプの修理をお願いしていた
なんでも屋さんが　ほかの仕事があるとかで

English.Text: I've got a leaky mako pipe in need of fixing, but the merc I sent to handle the repairs ran off to take another job.

Text: どこかへ　行ってしまわれました

English.Text: And here I thought we were out of the woods...

Text:
なにしろ　パイプ周辺はモンスターが多くて
わたしらでは　手が出せないのです

English.Text: I can't just send anyone either. Fiends're nesting near the site and they'll attack anyone who gets close.

Text:
せめて　状況の確認だけでも
代行してくれる人がいれば……

English.Text: Where am I going to find someone who can repair a pipeline and handle monsters?

Text:
やっほ～！
わたし　なんでも屋のキリエ

English.Text: Hello, hello, hello! It's everyone's favorite merc: Kyrie!

Text: 実は　魔晄パイプの修理をするはずだったんだけど

English.Text: So, here's the sitch: I was s'posed to fix that pipeline...

Text:
ほかの仕事が入っちゃって
ここを離れることになったの

English.Text: but I accidentally double-booked myself─whoops! So I had to peace out.

Text: いやはや　売れっ子はツライねえ

English.Text: Ah, the burden of being the golden girl.

Text:
というわけで　メモに
パイプ修理に必要な部品を書いておいたから

English.Text: Anyway! I left you─whoever you are─an itemized list of everything you need.

Text:
まあ　しっかり修理するなら
部品はたくさんあるといいけど

English.Text: Although...if you wanna make sure the pipe stays fixed, the more parts, the better.

Text:
そのへんはまかせるね～
ああ　そうそう

English.Text: But who's counting, right? Oh, which reminds me...

Text:
部品は　この先の
パイプのスクラップ置き場にあるから探してみて

English.Text: You should find a few scrap heaps near the pipelines─rummage through those for materials.

Text:
そんじゃ　あとは頼んだ
バイバ～イ！

English.Text: And I think that about covers it! Thanks and good luck!

Text:
やっほ～　なんでも屋さん
部品集めは順調ですか～？

English.Text: Greetings, my fellow merc! Are we working hard, or hardly working?

Text:
いきなりなんだけど　実は他の仕事が入っちゃって
ここを離れることになったの

English.Text: Speaking of work, I just stumbled on another job, so I'm gonna leave this one in your capable hands.

Text:
というわけで
魔晄パイプの修理　よろしくね！

English.Text: I hate to bounce, but I'm sure you'll get that pipe patched up.

Text: そんじゃ　バイバ～イ！

English.Text: Catch ya later. Peace!

Text: 集めた部品で修理しますか？

English.Text: Use the parts you've collected to fix the pipe?

Text: 修理する

English.Text: Yes

Text: 修理しない

English.Text: No

Text: ちゃんと修理できんだろうな

English.Text: And you're sure that you can fix this?

Text: なんだ！

English.Text: Company!

Text: なんだってんだよったく

English.Text: Damn, that was a tough bastard.

Text: 漏れた魔晄の影響だろう

English.Text: Mako probably mutated 'em.

Text: 報告に戻ろう

English.Text: Let's head back.

Text: ああ　みなさん

English.Text: Oh good, you're back.

Text:
おかげさまで　魔晄がちょろちょろとですが
流れ始めました

English.Text: Our mako supply's looking better by the minute─the tank's filling up, bit by bit.

Text:
たとえ　最低限の応急処置だとしても助かりました
ありがとうございます

English.Text: The flow isn't quite what it should be, but so long as we can provide power, it will suffice for our needs.

Text:
みなさん　いい感じに修理してくださり
ありがとうございます

English.Text:
You did an impressive job on those repairs.
Thank you all so much.

Text:
おかげさまで　魔晄の供給が再開しました
いやはや　これでひと安心です

English.Text: Now that we've got some mako to spare, we can finally restore power to most homes. What a relief!

Text: おお　みなさん

English.Text: Ah, you're back!

Text:
頑丈に修理していただいたみたいで
まことに　ありがとうございます

English.Text:
You must've done a real bang-up job out there.
Tank's practically full again!

Text:
おかげさまで　魔晄がじゃぶじゃぶと
タンクに流れ始めました

English.Text:
I don't think our supply's ever been this good.
We've more than enough for our needs!

Text: 前より　勢いがよくなった気がします

English.Text:
Don't know what you did to that pipe,
but thank god you did!

Text:
では　こちらが報酬です
お納めください

English.Text:
Here, a little something for your troubles.
Please, I insist.

Text:
ああ　あんたらアバランチだろ？
宿屋のブロードから　話は聞いてるよ

English.Text: Oh, y'all must be the ones with Avalanche, right? Broden told me a little bit about ya.

Text: うまく神羅から逃げてるみたいだな

English.Text: On the run from Shinra, eh?

Text: あんたらか　うまく逃げてるみたいだな

English.Text: Hey. Glad to see Shinra hasn't caught you yet.

Text: ちょうど良かった　仕事を頼めないか

English.Text:
Seein' as you're here,
mind helpin' me with something?

Text: 俺はオリバー　ここの農場主だ

English.Text: I'm Oliver, by the way. Owner of this farm.

Text:
実は　夜な夜な
うちの家畜が襲われて困ってるんだ

English.Text:
Got fiend trouble.
Every night it comes after my livestock.

Text:
犯人は　モンスターだろう
探し出して　退治してくれないか？

English.Text:
Least I assume a fiend's to blame.
Think you could find and deal with it?

Text: 依頼を引き受けますか？

English.Text: What will you say?

Text: モンスターの特徴は？

English.Text: What do you know about it?

Text: あんたとブロードの関係は？

English.Text: How do you know Broden?

Text: 引き受けよう

English.Text: Sure, we'll deal with it.

Text:
おそろしく頭のいいヤツさ
罠を仕掛けても　ものともしない

English.Text:
Not much, save the bastard's smart as hell.
Managed to evade every trap I've set.

Text: ハンターも雇ってるが　いまのところ成果ナシだ

English.Text:
Even hired a hunter to get rid of it,
but that was a bust.

Text:
俺は　グラスランドの自然が大好きでね
守りたいと思えば　反神羅の旗を掲げることになる

English.Text: The ecosystem here is somethin' special─worth protectin'. Don't want Shinra messin' it up, and I'm not afraid to say so out loud.

Text: そんな俺たちみたいのを　繋ぐヤツがいるのさ

English.Text: One day some like-minded folks came round.

Text:
ブロードやアバランチとは
その縁で知り合ったんだ

English.Text: They put me in touch with Broden and Avalanche.

Text: 立場は違うけど　情報交換は欠かさないよ

English.Text:
Impressive, the way that committee's
able to connect people.

Text: 助かる

English.Text: 'Preciate it!

Text: そのワンちゃん　あんたが飼ってるのか？

English.Text: That your dog there? Mind if I pet him?

Text: 犬扱いは　やめたほうがいい

English.Text: I don't...but he might.

Text: おお　よしよし　かわいいねえ

English.Text: Who's a good boy? It's you!

Text:
あはは　元気がいいな
犬の嗅覚なら　追跡できるかもしれない

English.Text: Somethin' tells me he's not all bark! Hey, y'know, your pup might be able to track the fiend's scent.

Text: いちど　犯行現場を調べてみてくれないか？

English.Text: Maybe try sniffin' around the scene of the crime?

Text:
これ以上　家畜が減ると
廃業もありえない話じゃない　まいるよ

English.Text: Truth be told, I'm one murdered animal away from losin' the whole farm. Goddamn fiends...

Text: 神羅は認めてないが

English.Text: Shinra'd never cop to it...

Text:
凶暴なモンスターが増えたのは
魔晄炉のせいに決まってる

English.Text: but all these monsters wouldn't be runnin' around if it wasn't for their reactors.

Text: ここか

English.Text: Here.

Text: ここだね

English.Text: This is it.

Text: わかるか？

English.Text: So?

Text:
犯行から数日経過しているな
生ぐさいほかの獣のニオイも混ざっている

English.Text: It's been several days since the attack, so the scent isn't fresh. Other animals have come and gone as well.

Text: 追跡は難しいだろう

English.Text: This won't be easy.

Text:
かなりニオイが消えちゃってる
追いかけるのは難しいかも

English.Text: The smell's really faded. Not sure how much help my nose is gonna be here.

Text: チョコボに嗅がせてみるか

English.Text: Think a chocobo could handle it?

Text:
ふん　チョコボの嗅覚が優れているとはいえ
これは無理だろう

English.Text:
Hmph. Their sense of smell is indeed impressive,
but this trail is still quite poor...

Text: ……が　試したいなら止めはしない

English.Text: Though if you wish to try, I won't stop you.

Text:
やってみてもいいけど
チョコボの鼻でも　どうかなあ

English.Text: It's worth a try. They might be able to pick up more than I can, but I wouldn't bet on it...

Text: クエ！

English.Text: Kweh!

Text: わかったみたいだぞ

English.Text: He's got something.

Text: んん？

English.Text: Wha─?

Text: えっ　ホント？

English.Text: What? Really?

Text: クエ！

English.Text: Kweh!

Text:
ふん　私も見当はついている
答えあわせといこうか

English.Text: Hmph... Well, I still have a faint impression of the scent. Together we can find the beast.

Text:
へえ～　オイラはまったくわかんなかったのに
チョコボの嗅覚って　やっぱりすごいね

English.Text: Wow... Not gonna lie, I couldn't smell anything. I had no idea chocobos were that good at tracking!

Text: ここで新たな獲物を襲ったようだな

English.Text: There was a struggle here not long ago.

Text: ここでまた獲物を襲ったみたい

English.Text: Smells like a really fresh kill here.

Text: 今度はレッドが調べてみるか？

English.Text: You wanna track it from here on out?

Text: 今度はナナキが調べてみるか？

English.Text: You wanna track it from here on out?

Text: いや　まずはチョコボにまかせてみよう

English.Text: No. The chocobo has led us this far, after all.

Text: ううん　チョコボにまかせるよ

English.Text: Nah... Think the chocobo's got this.

Text: クエ！

English.Text: Kweh!

Text: 私はチョコボが間違えないように　サポートしよう

English.Text: I can help guide the bird─ensure it doesn't stray.

Text: オイラ　がんばってサポートするね

English.Text: Well, I'm happy to lend my nose if needed!

Text: チョコボに嗅がせてみるか

English.Text: Maybe a chocobo could track it.

Text: クエ！

English.Text: Kweh!

Text: あいつだ

English.Text: There!

Text: あいつ？

English.Text: Found 'em!

Text: どうした？

English.Text: What?

Text:
神羅のビルに居たせいで
私の鼻は　すっかりなまってしまったらしい

English.Text: It's my sense of smell. Since my imprisonment in the Shinra Building, it hasn't been the same.

Text:
私だけでは　ここまで追跡できなかっただろう
チョコボのおかげだ

English.Text: Before, I wouldn't have had any trouble tracking that scent. Now, though...

Text:
オイラ　なんの役にも立たなかった
鼻には自信があったのに

English.Text: Tracking's always been kind of "my thing," but...I was worse than useless today.

Text: クエ！

English.Text: Kweh!

Text: ふん　チョコボに弟子入りすべきかもな

English.Text: Heh... Perhaps this bird is willing to take on an apprentice.

Text:
へへへ……
なぐさめてくれて　ありがとう

English.Text: Thanks for trying to cheer me up.

Text:
オイラ　立派な戦士になるためにも
この鼻から鍛え直すよ

English.Text: Going to have to seriously step up my sniffing game if I'm ever gonna be a real Watcher.

Text:
おおそうか　倒してくれたか
大変だったろ

English.Text:
You got him, didja? Made that bastard pay?
Nice goin'.

Text: もしかして　君が活躍してくれたのかな

English.Text: And I bet you were a big help too, weren't ya!

Text:
あはは　ご機嫌ナナメなワンちゃんに
ごほうびだ

English.Text: You'll be singing a different tune when you see what I got for ya.

Text: ほら！

English.Text: Here!

Text: こっちは　あんたへの報酬だ

English.Text: Don't worry, I didn't forget you.

Text: 話は変わるが　ブロードが体調を崩しているらしい

English.Text: Changin' gears a bit, but...I heard Broden's not feeling so hot.

Text:
もしカームに寄ることがあったら
見舞ってやってくれ

English.Text: If you swing by Kalm again, mind checkin' on him?

Text:
俺も　ブロードの見舞いに行きたいんだが
家畜の世話が忙しくてね

English.Text: Much as I wanna look in on Broden myself, I can't leave the farm unattended.

Text: 俺の代わりに　ブロードを見舞ってやってくれ

English.Text: Bit of an ask, I know, but you mind checking on him?

Text: 俺は　グラスランドの自然を守りたいんだ

English.Text: We've gotta preserve what's left of the grasslands, y'know?

Text: 自然を守るためにも　神羅をなんとかしないと

English.Text: Land won't last much longer if Shinra keeps doin' what they do.

Text: そうか　ブロードはニブルにいるのか

English.Text: What─you found him where? Nibelheim?

Text:
まさか魔晄中毒だったとは……
クソ　ぜんぶ神羅のせいだ

English.Text: Can't believe Broden was mako poisoned this whole time... Goddamn Shinra.

Text:
ウータイの放送　見たか
ようやく神羅を叩きのめす時がきたんだ

English.Text: Saw that broadcast outta Wutai. 'Bout time Shinra got a taste of their own medicine!

Text: もちろん　あんたらも参加するよな

English.Text: You're onboard, right? With the war.

Text:
反神羅連絡会への参加方法は
アバランチに聞けばわかるかな

English.Text: Hey, you think someone from Avalanche would know who to contact about joining the SRC?

Text: 君たちか　神羅をうまくまいたようだな

English.Text:
Oh, you're back...
I guess that means you managed to shake Shinra.

Text: 君たちか　元気そうだな

English.Text: Back again? Well, you're always welcome.

Text: あんたは　体調が良くないらしいな

English.Text: We heard that you've been feelin' under the weather lately.

Text: へえ　情報が早いな　心配してくれるのか

English.Text:
Word gets around fast...
Didn't expect you to worry about me.

Text: だったら　頼みを聞いてくれ

English.Text: But since you're here...can I ask you a favor?

Text:
知り合いに　風車の部品の仕入れを
頼まれていたんだが　この体調じゃ難しい

English.Text: A friend of mine wanted me to help her fix one of the old republic windmills, but...I'm in no condition to do that.

Text: 代わりに　やってくれないか？

English.Text: Do you think...you could instead?

Text:
どうする　彼には世話になった
借りは返すべきだろう

English.Text: I think we should help. If not for him, we'd probably be back in Hojo's lab.

Text:
ほら　この街から逃げる時に助けてもらったし
恩は返さないと

English.Text: Let's help him out. I mean, he did save our skins when we were on the run from Shinra. We owe him.

Text: 依頼を引き受けますか？

English.Text: What will you say?

Text: 体調は大丈夫なのか

English.Text: You don't look so good. What's wrong?

Text: あんたと神羅の関係は？

English.Text: How involved with Shinra were you?

Text: なぜ神羅と敵対している？

English.Text: Why're you pissed at Shinra?

Text: 引き受けよう

English.Text: We'll do it.

Text: 頭痛とめまいが　ひどくてね

English.Text: You know, headaches and dizziness.

Text:
若い頃に　色々無理をしたせいかな
ガタがきているのかもしれない

English.Text: Probably my misspent youth. Paying the price for it now. Hindsight's twenty-twenty...

Text: 頭痛とめまい　ほかには？

English.Text: Headaches and dizziness, huh...? Anything else?

Text:
ときどき　声が……
私を呼ぶ声が　聞こえる気がするんだが

English.Text: Sometimes I hear...voices, I guess? Calling for me─urging me to go somewhere.

Text: いや　なんでもない

English.Text: Sounds pretty crazy, saying it aloud.

Text: 若い頃は　軍に所属していた

English.Text: I was a company grunt years ago.

Text:
両親が亡くなったのを機に
神羅を抜けて　家業を継いだってわけさ

English.Text: But when my parents died, I got out to take care of the family business. Been running the place ever since.

Text:
話せば長くなる
簡潔に言えば　家族と故郷を奪われた

English.Text: I'll spare you the grisly details, and just say they stole my life from me. My family. My home.

Text: 恨むには　じゅうぶんな理由だろ

English.Text: Is that reason enough for you?

Text: 故郷は　ここではないのか

English.Text: But I thought Kalm was your home.

Text: あれ　ここは故郷じゃないの？

English.Text: Wait... I thought Kalm was your home.

Text:
この街はいちど　神羅によって破壊されてる
再建されても　故郷という気はもうしない

English.Text: Not anymore. This isn't the Kalm I grew up in. My Kalm was destroyed by Shinra, and this? A soulless imitation...

Text: ここにいるのは　恨みつらみを忘れないためさ

English.Text: but I stayed, 'cause I won't let myself forget what those bastards took.

Text: ふん　不健康な生き方だ

English.Text: Hmph. Living in hate can poison a man.

Text:
つらいね　悔しいね
ねえクラウド　力になろうよ

English.Text: I...I can't even imagine how that must feel. C'mon, Cloud. Let's lend him a hand.

Text: 助かる

English.Text: Thank you.

Text:
詳しいことは　ミルドという女に聞いてくれ
海沿いの廃集落に住んでいる

English.Text: My friend's name is Mildred. You should be able to find her somewhere around the old settlement, out on the cliffside.

Text: 風車が目印だ

English.Text: Look for the windmills.

Text: 君たちか　神羅をうまくまいたようだな

English.Text:
Oh, you're back...
I guess that means you managed to shake Shinra.

Text:
どこに神羅の関係者がいるかわからない
あまり目立たないようにな

English.Text: You never know who might be a Shinra collaborator. Watch what you say and who you say it to.

Text: 休んでいくなら　歓迎するよ

English.Text: You're welcome to stay the night, if you want.

Text:
すまんな　依頼人の名前はミルドだ
ちょっと変わってるが　悪いヤツじゃない

English.Text: Sorry to put you to the trouble. Just to reiterate, my friend's name is Mildred. She's an odd duck, but a true sweetheart.

Text:
ミルドには　凄腕が行くと伝えておこう
よろしく頼むよ

English.Text: I'll go ahead and tell her that...that help's on the way. Thanks again for doing this.

Text: ブロードの友達？

English.Text: Did Broden send you?

Text: 来てくれて　ありがとう

English.Text: I'm glad for the company.

Text: どうだい　美しいだろ

English.Text: Ain't she a sight to behold?

Text:
共和国時代のものだ
神羅とは設計思想から違う

English.Text:
A relic of the Republic of Junon.
Shinra can't make 'em like this, lemme tell ya.

Text: 私はこいつを　どうしても動かしてみたくてね

English.Text:
I'm itching to scrape the rust off─
get her moving again.

Text:
それなのに　ピッチ制御用のギアだけが
どうしても手に入らないんだ

English.Text: Easier said than done, unfortunately. The rotor's missing a key component, one that's a bitch to find.

Text:
というわけで　君たちには
ギアを手に入れてきてもらいたい

English.Text: Which is where you come in! I'm gonna need your help to get me that part.

Text: なにか　質問はあるかな？

English.Text: So, whaddya wanna know?

Text: なにか　質問はあるかな？

English.Text: What do you want to know?

Text: ギアの入手方法

English.Text: How to obtain the part.

Text: ギアを作るための素材

English.Text: What transmutation materials we need.

Text: ブロードとの関係

English.Text: How you know Broden.

Text: ブロードは神羅でなにを？

English.Text: What happened between Broden and Shinra.

Text: ブロードは治るのか？

English.Text: If Broden will get better.

Text: 特にない

English.Text: Nothing. We're good.

Text:
現在は生産されていない部品だ
アイテムクラフトで作れるはずだ

English.Text: Not through any shop, that's for sure. It's outta production, so you'll have to make it yourself.

Text:
おっ　すでにクラフトチップは持ってるみたいだね
さすがブロードの友達　優秀じゃないか

English.Text: But that oughta be easy for you, seein' as you already found the chip. Nice work. Broden was right to send you my way.

Text:
じゃあ　次は
レシピどおりの素材を集めてきてくれ

English.Text: Now all that's left to do is put that transmuter of yours to work.

Text:
まずは　クラフトチップを
手に入れるところからだね

English.Text: So, first things first...the transmuter chip.

Text:
レシピがわかれば　そのあと
素材をそろえてクラフトするだけさ　簡単だろ？

English.Text: Once you got that squared away, it should be as easy as poppin' in the materials ya need. Piece of cake, right?

Text: お話はうかがっていました

English.Text: Perhaps I can be of service.

Text:
共和国時代の情報でしたら
ライフスポットを解析してみてください

English.Text: If you wish to learn more about the Republic of Junon, I recommend visiting lifesprings.

Text:
クラフトチップが眠る場所や
ほかにも　色々とわかるはずです

English.Text: The knowledge they contain will reveal the location of transmuter chips...

Text:
というわけで　ワールドレポートの調査
よろしくお願いしますね！

English.Text: as well as other points of interest. I hope that helps your search!

Text: ライフスポットの解析を進めよう

English.Text: Okay. Lifesprings it is.

Text:
草原を駆け巡りながら
いにしえの知識を探索するのも悪くない

English.Text: Fine by me. Only fitting that we learn the history of the planet as we seek to cross her.

Text: おさんぽ　おさんぽ　おっさんぽ～！

English.Text: Oh boy! An adventure! C'mon!

Text:
まずは　クラフトチップを
手に入れるところからだね

English.Text: So, first things first...the transmuter chip.

Text:
レシピがわかれば　そのあと
素材をそろえてクラフトするだけさ　簡単だろ？

English.Text: Once you got that squared away, it should be as easy as poppin' in the materials ya need. Piece of cake, right?

Text: ライフスポットの解析を進めよう

English.Text: Right. Let's check some lifesprings.

Text:
クラフトチップは見つけたようだね
じゃあ次は　アイテムクラフトだ

English.Text: Step one was scoring a transmuter chip─which you did. So now we put that baby to work.

Text:
必要な素材は　グラスランドに生息する
ケツァルコアトルという鳥から採れるんだが

English.Text: As for the ingredients...you'll need to bag the quetzalcoatl─this rare bird─to get what you need.

Text:
なんだ　すでに素材はそろってるじゃないか
あとはアイテムクラフトでギアを作るだけだよ

English.Text: Huh? Oh, you already procured the stuff? Well, aren't you an efficient one. In that case, only thing left to do is to transmute the part.

Text:
魔晄炉の影響か　最近は見かけなくてね
どうだい　探せそうかい？

English.Text: Not that anyone's seen it lately. Sure Shinra's to blame for that too...but maybe you'll have better luck.

Text: ライフスポットの解析を進めよう

English.Text: Time to tap into some lifesprings.

Text: ああ

English.Text: Yeah.

Text: うん

English.Text: Yeah.

Text: ふむ　いわゆる幼馴染みというやつだな

English.Text: We go way back... Like, way back.

Text:
ふたりとも　若い頃に街を出てね
世界中の風景を見てまわったよ

English.Text: The two of us skipped town when we were young, y'know. Thought we'd experience what the world had to offer.

Text:
それから彼は神羅軍に入隊し
私はエンジニアになったというわけだ

English.Text: Eventually, we went our separate ways. He joined the military, and I became an engineer.

Text: 優秀な兵士として　活躍していたみたいだよ

English.Text: Well, turned out he was a natural-born trooper.

Text:
しばらくして　なにか特別な実験に参加すると言って
連絡が取れなくなってね

English.Text: Was even handpicked to take part in a "supersecret" experiment. It wasn't long after that we lost contact.

Text: 再会した時には　彼は神羅を抜けていた

English.Text:
By the time we reconnected,
he'd already put that life behind him.

Text: なんの実験だ？

English.Text: What "experiment"?

Text: さあ　詳しくは教えてくれない

English.Text: Have to ask him...though I doubt he'd tell you.

Text:
ただ　彼の体調の悪化は
その実験の後遺症ではないかと私は考えている

English.Text: Certainly won't tell me, at any rate. Whatever they did to him, though, has somethin' to do with his condition. I just know it.

Text:
医者にも診てもらったようだが
原因がわからないらしい

English.Text: He's been to doctor after doctor, but all the tests come back inconclusive.

Text:
私も　かつて失われた技術の中に
治療方法がないかと調べているんだが

English.Text: So I'm digging through old republic archives, looking for something that might help─something a doctor might overlook.

Text: いまのところ　おてあげだ

English.Text: Just hope I find what he needs soon...

Text: それじゃあ　よろしく頼むよ

English.Text: Windmill's countin' on ya, friend.

Text: 共和国の風車だ　美しいだろ

English.Text: Magnificent, isn't it? A republic original.

Text: う～ん　なんとか動かせないものか

English.Text: If only there were some way to get it moving again.

Text: なにか　質問はあるかな？

English.Text: So, what d'ya wanna know?

Text:
クラウドさん
いま発見されたクラフトチップが

English.Text: Excellent! It seems you've found the transmuter chip.

Text:
ミルドさんが探されている
『風車のギア』のレシピです

English.Text: With it, you'll be able to create the item Mildred needs.

Text:
あとは　レシピどおりの素材をそろえて
作るだけですね

English.Text: You need only collect the requisite materials and craft the part.

Text:
もし　素材が見つからない場合は
ライフスポットの解析を進めてみてください

English.Text: If you're having trouble tracking them down, then you may want to try analyzing more lifesprings.

Text: 珍しいクラフトチップを発見しましたね

English.Text: That's quite the transmuter chip you've found.

Text:
共和国時代に使われていた
風車の部品が　作れるようです

English.Text: In fact, it was once used in the construction of windmills.

Text:
現在は入手困難な部品なので
もしかしたら　誰か探されているかもしれません

English.Text: Given its rarity, I would not be surprised if someone had need of such technology.

Text: ケツァルコアトルの討伐を確認しました

English.Text: Confirmed: quetzalcoatl defeated.

Text: コングラチュレーション　クラウド様！

English.Text: Amazing work as always, Cloud!

Text:
皆様の勇姿　わたくし
しかと目に焼きつけましたよ

English.Text: Your heroic victory over that vicious creature was a feast for the eyes!

Text:
クラウドさん　ＭＡＩがうるさかったら
いつでも言ってくださいね

English.Text: I suppose it falls to me to make MAI's presence more tolerable.

Text:
あれ？
音量が小さく……ちょっと――

English.Text: How do you─ Volume levels decreasing!? Wait!

Text:
あらためましてクラウドさん
モンスターの討伐　ご苦労様でした

English.Text: Now then, allow me to congratulate you on your victory over that beast...

Text: おかげさまで　貴重な生体データが手に入りました

English.Text: and thank you for the valuable biological data!

Text:
それと　入手された『ケツァルコアトルの爪』は
とても珍しい素材です

English.Text: You were likewise able to obtain something of great import: the beast's talon!

Text:
クラフトで　使えるかもしれません
なくさないようにしてくださいね

English.Text: I suspect that it can be used in the creation of something astounding!

Text: それに　これで『風車のギア』を作成できますね

English.Text: You should now be able to craft the requisite part for the windmill.

Text:
早速クラフトして
ミルドさんに届けてあげましょう

English.Text: No doubt Mildred is impatiently awaiting its delivery.

Text: 風車のギアを渡しますか？

English.Text: Hand over the gear?

Text: 渡す

English.Text: Yes

Text: 渡さない

English.Text: No

Text:
おお　すばらしい！
やっぱり共和国スタイルの部品は美しいなあ

English.Text: Now that is a quality design! No Shinra knockoffs can compare to republic ingenuity!

Text: 早速　風車にセットしてみよう

English.Text: Okay, time to see if she works!

Text: わははは　きたきたきた～！

English.Text: Hahaha! Hot damn, look at that!

Text: すごいすごいすごい　見てくれ！

English.Text: It's amazing─incredible! Wow...

Text:
海風を受けてブレードがまわっている
興奮する～！

English.Text: The blades are spinning─actually spinning! What a sight!

Text: あとは　どれぐらいエネルギーを生み出せるかだな

English.Text: Oh, I can't wait to find out how much power it can generate!

Text:
願わくば　昔みたいにブロードといっしょに
この光景を見たかったんだがな

English.Text: I wish Broden was here for this. He'd've loved to see these windmills running again. Maybe one day.

Text:
とにかく　ありがとう
夢がひとつ叶ったよ

English.Text: Well, anyway...thank you. You've helped me fulfill a dream of mine.

Text: これから　カームへ戻るのかい

English.Text: Guess you're heading back to Kalm?

Text: そのつもりだ

English.Text: That's the plan.

Text: ブロードに会ったら　伝えてくれ

English.Text: When you see Broden, you tell him...

Text:
『さっさと体調を治せ
　そして　いつかまた旅に出よう』ってね

English.Text: "Hurry up an' get better, wouldja? We got a whole wide world to see..." Or, something along those lines.

Text:
願わくば　昔みたいにブロードといっしょに
この光景を見たかったんだがな

English.Text: I wish Broden was here for this. He'd've loved to see these windmills running again. Maybe one day.

Text: ブロードに会ったら　伝えてくれ

English.Text: When you see Broden, you tell him...

Text:
『さっさと体調を治せ
　そしていつかまた　旅に出よう』ってね

English.Text: "Hurry up an' get better, wouldja? We got a whole wide world to see..." Or, something along those lines.

Text: やはり　共和国の技術は面白いなあ

English.Text: Something about republic tech just speaks to me...

Text:
さすがに　魔晄と比べれば
エネルギー変換率はおとるか

English.Text: But when it comes to energy output, it can't hold a candle to mako.

Text:
風車のデータをとったら
次は　なにを蘇らせようかな

English.Text: Once I figure out how these windmills work, I bet I can get even more old tech running!

Text:
共和国と神羅の技術のいいところどりができたら
すばらしいと思わないかい？

English.Text: Imagine combining Junon engineering with Shinra's. I mean, the possibilities'd be endless!

Text: なるほど　ブロードはニブルで療養中か

English.Text: Oh...so Broden's getting treatment near Nibelheim, huh?

Text: いっしょに旅に出るのは　しばらくおあずけだな

English.Text: Guess I'll just have to keep those travel plans of ours on the back burner.

Text:
そうか
ミルドのやつ　はしゃいでたろ

English.Text: That so...? If Mildred's happy, I'm happy.

Text: 『また旅に出よう』と伝えろと

English.Text: She said you've got a world to see.

Text:
そりゃ楽しみだ
ずっと　働きづめだったからな

English.Text:
She just wants an excuse to travel.
But...I am overdue for a vacation.

Text: 思いきって　長期休暇もいいかもな

English.Text: Think I've been working myself too hard lately.

Text: そうしたほうがいい

English.Text: Rest would do you good.

Text: うん　そうだね

English.Text: Yeah... Think some rest would do you good.

Text:
ひどく嫌なニオイがする
まるで宝条の実験室にいた――

English.Text:
What is this terrible scent?
It's reminiscent of...Hojo's lab.

Text:
あのね　すごく嫌なニオイがするんだ
まるで宝条の実験室にいた――

English.Text:
Do you smell that? It's terrible...
and it reminds me of...Hojo's lab?

Text:
旅だ……
そうだな　旅に出ないと

English.Text: It's time... Time to go. To leave...

Text:
旅だ……
そうだな　旅に出ないと

English.Text: It's time... Time to go. To leave...

Text: うう　ああ……

English.Text: Urng... Eh... Uh...

Text: うう　ああ……

English.Text: Aaah...hih... Aaah!

Text: 大丈夫か？

English.Text: You okay?

Text:
元ソルジャーの宿命さ
いわゆる……劣化だ

English.Text: It's just...the degradation. Every SOLDIER's gotta make their peace with it.

Text: だから　普通の医者にはわからない

English.Text: Now you know why I can't see any old doctor.

Text: おまえも　ソルジャーなんだろ

English.Text: You're a SOLDIER too, aren't you?

Text: 元ソルジャーだ

English.Text: Ex-SOLDIER, actually.

Text:
悪いな　不安にさせるつもりはなかった
それに必ずこうなるわけじゃない

English.Text: Didn't mean to scare you. The symptoms aren't always the same. And who knows? You might be one of the lucky ones...

Text: ああ

English.Text: Right...

Text: まだ若いんだ　まっすぐ生きろ

English.Text: Just...don't take your youth for granted, alright?

Text:
やりたいことをやれ
神羅の呪縛に屈するものか　なあ？

English.Text: You only get one shot at life...and you can't let Shinra take it from you. You can't let them win.

Text:
ミルドの風車を見るためにも
はやく体を治さないとな

English.Text: Need to rest...get my strength up. So I can see Mildred's windmills.

Text:
ソルジャーには　いろんな噂がある
いちいち気にするな

English.Text: People love to spread rumors about SOLDIERs. Don't you pay them any mind.

Text:
劣化の噂は聞いていたが　正直なところ
実際に襲われるまで　信じていなかったんだ

English.Text: I'd heard the rumors about cellular degradation, but didn't believe 'em. Didn't want to believe 'em─till I had no choice.

Text:
軍から抜けて再開した宿屋だ
病気なんかで　たたむわけにはいかない

English.Text: I left the service to keep this place and my parents' memory alive. I'll be damned if I lose it too 'cause of this...illness.

Text: ミッドガルが大変な状況らしいな

English.Text: I hear Midgar's a mess right now.

Text:
魔晄炉爆破に続いて
巨大ハリケーン発生だって？

English.Text: Two reactors get bombed, and then they get hit by some freak cyclone?

Text:
アバランチとウータイが組んで
破壊工作してるんだろ

English.Text: I dunno how Avalanche and Wutai did it, but they did it.

Text:
ミッドガルが封鎖されると
俺の仕事もヤバいな

English.Text: I'm gonna have trouble making ends meet with Midgar on lockdown.

Text:
アバランチってのは　何様だ
ぶっとばしてやりてえ

English.Text: Who do those Avalanche assholes think they are? Buncha jerks.

Text:
カームの魔晄エネルギーは
どうなっちゃうんだろう

English.Text: It won't affect the mako pipeline, will it?

Text:
ミッドガルに用事があるのに
しばらく無理か～

English.Text: So much for all those errands I had to run in Midgar.

Text:
アバランチに
カームも襲われたりしないよね

English.Text: Avalanche won't bomb us too, will they?

Text:
ウータイとの戦争が始まったら
どうなっちゃうの

English.Text: What'll happen to us if another war really does break out?

Text:
ミッドガルの七番プレートが
落ちたって　本当？

English.Text: You're telling me the Sector 7 plate, like, fell?

Text:
『カームへようこそ！』なんて
期待すんじゃねえぞ

English.Text: If you're expectin' a friendly howdy-do, look elsewhere!

Text:
現在は　ミッドガル事件への
対応が最優先！

English.Text: We have our hands full dealing with the refugees.

Text:
ミッドガル方面は封鎖中だ
不用意に街を出るな

English.Text: Midgar's under lockdown, so no point headin' up that way.

Text:
現在のモンスター注意報は
危険警報状態だ

English.Text: The Kalm monster advisory level is currently at critical!

Text:
ミッドガル方面から流出した
魔晄の影響で　グラスランドの
モンスターも暴れだしている

English.Text: The mako outflow from Midgar has stirred up the monster population, making them especially dangerous.

Text: 街を出るのは禁止だ！

English.Text: Leaving town is strictly forbidden!

Text:
ちょっと
今日デートするなんて不謹慎じゃない

English.Text: Um, is this really the time to be going out on a date?

Text: ミッドガルの事件　聞いたでしょ？

English.Text: You heard what happened in Midgar, right?

Text:
魔晄炉連続爆破にプレート落下
おまけに竜巻だろ？

English.Text: Some reactors were bombed, a plate fell, and then a tornado rolled through town.

Text:
ってことは　つまり
世界が終わる運命ってことさ

English.Text: Taken all together, it's enough to suggest the whole world's coming to an end.

Text:
ふ～ん　運命の日に
私を選んだってことね
いいじゃない　つきあってあげる

English.Text: So, what? The apocalypse comes and you decide you want to spend your final moments with me? Huh. That's weirdly romantic.

Text:
おいおい　どうするオレ
まずいぞオレ

English.Text: This is a disaster... What am I supposed to do now?

Text:
アバランチの起こした事件で
仕事がストップ

English.Text: All work's been put on hold because of that shit with Avalanche.

Text:
あれもこれも　買ったばかり
飲み屋のツケも溜まってる

English.Text: And right after I went on that shopping spree too. Not to mention my tab...

Text:
アバランチは立て替えてくれるのか
それとも　神羅に請求すりゃいいのか？

English.Text: Maybe I should try to get Avalanche to pay for it all. Or...I guess I could file a claim with Shinra.

Text:
はあ～　空気がうめえ
アバランチ様のおかげで束の間の休日だ

English.Text: That sweet, fresh air... Hats off to Avalanche for the mandatory vacation.

Text: せいいっぱい　楽しまねえとな

English.Text: Savor these brief respites.

Text:
ミッドガルへのガタゴトロードは
ケツが痛くてたまらねえ

English.Text: When you can get off those pothole-riddled roads and give your sore behind a rest.

Text: このイスは　揺れねえだけで最高だ

English.Text: Shinra really oughta do something about that.

Text:
ほら　サボんないで
さっさと終わらせるよ！

English.Text: Hey, quit slacking! We haven't got all day.

Text:
風車村を見に行きたい　ボク知ってるよ
共和国時代の廃墟なんだよね

English.Text: I wanna see the windmills! My teacher said that they're "remnants" from when the republic was still around.

Text: 歴史の勉強にもなるしさ

English.Text: It'll be like a history field trip.

Text: ガマンしなさい

English.Text: I'm sorry, buddy.

Text: 遺跡めぐりのツアーが中止なんだ

English.Text: But all the windmill tours have been canceled.

Text:
聞け弟よ　すげえカワイイ子がいたんだ
ピンクのスカートで　髪にはリボン！

English.Text: I just spied the cutest chick. Light pink dress, ribbon in her hair... I think I'm in love, man! Can't let this one get away.

Text:
本当かい兄さん
僕も　腹筋ピッチピチの新顔発見！

English.Text: Seriously, bro? Well, I spotted a girl with the best physique I've ever seen!

Text:
よ～し　新顔をチェックするぞ
モテない男同盟のために！

English.Text: Wow, I can't believe I missed her! As a founding member of the Singles Club, I should've been paying more attention!

Text: その同盟　僕らふたりだけだけどね

English.Text: You do know we're the only ones in that club, right?

Text:
でもさ　カワイイ子を発見したあとは
どうすりゃいいの？

English.Text: So, uh... What exactly are we supposed to do after we spot a cute chick?

Text: 案ずるな　弟よ

English.Text: Fear not, brother!

Text:
エレファダンクのように
ドカーンと当たってくだけろだ！

English.Text: All you gotta do is channel your inner elphadunk, then charge!

Text:
じゃあ僕は　カームファングのように
まっしぐら作戦だ！

English.Text: Okay! I picture myself as more of a wolf, but I can do that!

Text:
よ～し　モテない男同盟
解散の時は近い！

English.Text: That's the spirit! Say g'bye to single life and say hello to girls galore!

Text:
ミッドガルから避難してきたけど
大変だったよ

English.Text: God, it was a bitch and a half gettin' out here from Midgar.

Text: 道も悪いし　モンスターもヤバくてさ

English.Text: The roads were a mess─not to mention all the monsters.

Text:
あなたが急に
カームに避難しようなんて言うから

English.Text: Well, it was your bright idea to pack up and flee to Kalm!

Text: どーすんのよ　これから

English.Text: So what're we supposed to do now!?

Text: まあ　ゆっくりしていってくれよ

English.Text: Well, go ahead and make yourselves at home.

Text:
ミッドガルに比べたら
仕事も娯楽も　なにもないけどな

English.Text: Though I imagine it'll take you some time to get used to life here in the sticks.

Text:
工場長が新商品作るって言って
ここんとこ　ず～っと残業ですよ

English.Text: Been no end to the overtime ever since the boss decided to take on a buncha new orders.

Text:
うちも　そんな感じですなあ
『カームこけし』で街おこしするって

English.Text: Yeah, it's the same with me. Making wooden dolls day in, day out.

Text:
こっちは休みだよ
ミッドガル封鎖のおかげでな

English.Text: Meanwhile, we've all been forced to take leave 'cause of Midgar gettin' locked down.

Text: 給料も出ない

English.Text: Unpaid leave.

Text:
魔晄タンクのメーター
減ってるよな？

English.Text: The meter on the mako tank's clearly gone down.

Text:
プレジデントの乗ったヘリが落ちて
ヤバイらしいぞ

English.Text: So the president died in a helicopter crash?

Text:
アバランチ　やりすぎだよ
魔晄がなきゃ生活できないのに

English.Text: Avalanche's downright crazy. How the hell d'they expect us to live without mako!?

Text:
ここにも竜巻がきたら
家が吹っ飛ぶよな？

English.Text: If a twister like that hit us, I could kiss my house goodbye.

Text:
アバランチの一味が
ミッドガルから逃亡中らしい

English.Text: I heard those Avalanche guys left Midgar and are on the run now.

Text:
友達が心配だけど
全然電話つながらない　どうしよう

English.Text: I can't get a hold of my friend! What should I do? What if they're...

Text:
神羅は　新社長が就任か
かっこいいのかな？

English.Text: So junior is the new president? I can't even remember what he looks like.

Text:
うちの洗濯機　動かなくなっちゃったの
魔晄エネルギーが減ってるせいかな

English.Text: My washing machine's given up the ghost. You don't think it's got something to do with the drop in mako, do you?

Text:
ミッドガルから避難してきた人
けっこう　いるね

English.Text: It's honestly frightening how many people have evacuated from Midgar.

Text:
アバランチ恨むわ～
神羅抜きじゃ暮らせないのに

English.Text: Oh, please. Does Avalanche really think we can get by without Shinra?

Text:
新社長就任のウワサって知ってる？
プレジデント　病気で重体なんだって

English.Text: You know why Rufus had to step up, don't you? Everyone's saying it's 'cause his dad caught something─the man's on his deathbed.

Text: ミッドガルニュース放送局で言ってた

English.Text: The Midgar news broadcasts back it up.

Text:
ま～た
おカタいラジオなんか聞いちゃって

English.Text: You're still listening to that crap? Wake up already!

Text:
プレジデントは
アバランチに暗殺されたんだよ

English.Text: The president isn't sick; he was assassinated by Avalanche!

Text: アンタの　その情報の出どころ

English.Text: According to your "sources" maybe.

Text:
ウォール・マーケットラジオとかいう
あやしいやつでしょうが

English.Text: I wouldn't trust anything Wall Market Radio says.

Text:
あの子　災害に
巻き込まれてないだろうね

English.Text: Just thinking about what might've happened to my family makes me sick.

Text:
連絡してもかけ直せばかりで通じないし
本当に無事なんだろうか

English.Text: I've tried to contact them so many times now, but...nothing. I can only pray that they're safe.

Text:
我らが魔晄炉視察団は　定期的に
ミッドガルの魔晄炉視察を実施してきた

English.Text: Our inspection team conducts routine surveys of Midgar's reactors─or we used to.

Text:
だが　今期は魔晄炉爆破の影響で中止
はあ……行きたかったな　魔晄炉視察

English.Text: Goes without saying the bombings put a hard stop to all that. I live for the on-site work. Job's just not the same without it.

Text:
オレさ　ついに
ネコ飼っちゃったんだよね

English.Text: It took me long enough, but I finally went and got myself a cat!

Text: もう可愛くてさ　写真撮りまくり！

English.Text: He's so cute. My camera roll's filling up!

Text:
わかるわかる　うちのワンコも可愛くて
もう毎日写真撮ってるよ

English.Text: I feel that. I'm the same way with my dog. I just gotta snap a pic of everything he does.

Text:
そうだよね　同じ姿勢なのに
ついつい撮っちゃう

English.Text: I know, right? I swear I have, like, a million photos of Cactie.

Text:
みんなも見る？
サボちゃんの写真　可愛いよ～

English.Text: Wanna see 'em? I'm telling you, she's adorable.

Text:
ほんと　どこでサボテンダー拾ったの
この近くには　いないよね？

English.Text: How did you even get your hands on a cactuar? They're not local, right?

Text:
遅い……遅すぎる　いや
俺が早すぎたのか？

English.Text: She's late. Too late... Or am I here too early?

Text: １日前から待つのは　早すぎたか！

English.Text: Was getting here a day ahead of time overkill?

Text:
今日こそ告白するからって
気合い入れすぎたか？　でも
週刊恋愛占いモテオとモテコには

English.Text: Maybe I got a little carried away with this whole proposal business... But the weekly horoscope was crystal clear!

Text:
出会いを気長に待つべしって
書いてあったし

English.Text: "Preparation is key." How else am I supposed to interpret that?

Text:
次は　見晴らし塔に登りたい
ミッドガルが見たい！

English.Text: I wanna go up the clock tower next! You can see Midgar from there.

Text:
弐番と参番のプレートが無事なのか
確認しなくちゃ

English.Text: I gotta check to make sure Sectors 2 and 3 are alright!

Text: あなたは本当にミッドガルが好きねえ

English.Text: Always looking out for your city, aren't you?

Text:
将来はソルジャーになって
ミッドガルを守るんだもんね

English.Text: One day, I'll be telling everyone how you made it into SOLDIER.

Text:
やったわ！
収穫祭の踊り子に選ばれたの

English.Text: Guess what!? I'm gonna get to dance in the harvest festival!

Text:
すごいじゃないか
じゃあ　もう衣装は届いたの？

English.Text: Congratulations! Have you gotten your costume yet?

Text: 見せてほしいな

English.Text: I'd love to see it.

Text:
いいな～　早くわたしも
踊り子に選ばれたいな

English.Text: That's so cool! I hope I can be a dancer too when I grow up!

Text:
クイーンズ・ブラッドって
カードゲーム　知ってる？

English.Text: Hey, Dad, have you heard of Queen's Blood?

Text:
みんなやってるから
やりたいんだ　買ってよ

English.Text: All the kids at school are playin' it! You gotta buy it for me.

Text:
よ～し　買ってあげよう
僕もやりたかったんだ

English.Text: Sure thing, son. Was thinking of givin' it a try myself.

Text:
へへ　魔晄タンクちゃん
今日も可愛いなあ

English.Text: Hoho... Looking adorable as ever, my darling little mako tank.

Text:
ここ　汚れてるな
いまキレイにしてあげるからね

English.Text: Oh no! You've got a bit of a stain. Don't worry, I'll take care of that for you.

Text:
あのセンパイ　またタンクなでてるよ
いやいや　可愛いのはパイプだろ

English.Text: That weirdo's whispering sweet nothings to the mako tank again. Can't he see the pipes've got it going on?

Text: この　磨かれたツヤがいいんだよな

English.Text: The way they glisten in the sunlight...

Text:
魔晄炉のある場所の土地は
やせてしまう

English.Text: Reactors are terrible for nearby farmlands.

Text:
カームの魔晄は
ミッドガルから来てるんだ

English.Text: Which is why I'm glad we get our mako from Midgar.

Text:
エネルギーだけ供給してもらうのが
いちばんいい

English.Text: Let them deal with the fallout while we reap the benefits.

Text: さあ　元気よく行くよ！

English.Text: And don't forget to smile!

Text: カウント　まちがえないでね

English.Text: Make sure you stay on the beat!

Text: ようこそ　カーム・インをご利用ですか？

English.Text: Hello! Welcome to the Inn at Kalm.

Text: いらっしゃいませ　どうぞごゆっくり

English.Text: Please, make yourself at home.

Text: いってらっしゃいませ

English.Text: Safe travels!

Text:
カーム・インのご利用
ありがとうございました

English.Text: We hope you found your stay with us refreshing.

Text:
お客様が心地よく過ごせるように
念入りに掃除しておかないと

English.Text: I need to keep this place looking spick-and-span. Don't wanna let Broden down.

Text:
掃除だけはうまいって
ブロードさんにも　ほめられたんだから

English.Text: Especially after he insisted I focus exclusively on cleaning!

Text:
現在　ミッドガルは
かつてない危機にさらされています

English.Text: Of course, this is only the most recent in a series of crises.

Text:
魔晄炉爆破事件
七番プレート崩壊につづき

English.Text: Multiple reactor bombings, followed by the fall of the Sector 7 plate...

Text:
ミッドガル・ハイウェイに
突如発生した竜巻が

English.Text: culminating in this unprecedented destruction...

Text:
零番街から　弐番街にいたる区画に
甚大な被害をもたらしました

English.Text: caused by a massive tornado, which swept through Sectors 0, 1, and 2.

Text:
ドミノ市長と市当局は
神羅カンパニーの助言を得て

English.Text: After a briefing with Shinra investigators, Mayor Domino released a statement...

Text:
この竜巻は　反神羅勢力
『アバランチ』による

English.Text: declaring the tornado to be, quote, "weather warfare..."

Text:
未知の兵器を使った攻撃である
という見解を発表しました

English.Text: perpetrated by the infamous insurgent group known as Avalanche.

Text:
現在停戦中の
ウータイの関与も視野に入れて
引き続き　調査するとのことです

English.Text: The administration also suspects the involvement of Wutai─and has begun investigations into the matter.

Text:
魔晄炉爆破とか　プレート落下とか
ミッドガルはどうなっちまうんだろうな

English.Text: Between the reactor bombings and a whole plate falling, hard to see how Midgar'll ever be the same.

Text:
ウータイと神羅の戦争が始まったら
カームは前線基地だ

English.Text: If Wutai really does declare war, Kalm'll be in the crosshairs.

Text: 巻き込まれるかもな

English.Text: Where would we go?

Text:
カームのワインは繊細です
些細なことで　すぐに味が落ちてしまう

English.Text: Kalm's wine grapes are very delicate. The slightest change in conditions and bam─your crop is ruined.

Text:
このご時世では
苦みが増すでしょうな

English.Text: Feels like every new vintage has been more bitter than the last.

Text:
渋みにまで至るやもしれん
いやはや　心配です

English.Text: Might even get to the point where I can't choke it down. That'd be a crying shame.

Text:
ついに手に入れたのよ
欲しかったレアカード！

English.Text: I finally got my hands on that super rare card I've been after!

Text: ほほう　やりましたねえ

English.Text: Wow! Congratulations!

Text:
これでまた
理想のデッキに近づいたのでは？

English.Text: Now you're one step closer to creating your ideal deck.

Text: どこで手に入れたんだ？

English.Text: So, where'd you get it?

Text:
もちろんグラスランドのカードハウスよ
裏ルートで　特別に仕入れてもらったの

English.Text: At that specialty shop out in the grasslands, of course. The owner used his "special connections" to get it for me.

Text:
コスモキャニオンの
カクテル言葉を知っているかい？

English.Text: Know what the Cosmo Canyon cocktail symbolizes?

Text:
『運命の星はそこにある』
君が僕のスターってことさ

English.Text: The guiding star of destiny─that's what you mean to me. My glorious goddess.

Text:
え～　ホント～？
わたしが　お星様ってこと？

English.Text: Really? So does that mean I'm your "one and only"?

Text: このわたしを　口説いてるの～？

English.Text: Or are you just giving me the same line you give all the girls?

Text:
僕がコスモキャニオンを頼むのは
特別な出会いを感じたときだけさ

English.Text: Heh... I only order a Cosmo Canyon when I know I've met someone truly special.

Text:
ああ　遅刻遅刻！
ニュース聞いてたら遅れちゃったよ

English.Text: Crap, I'm gonna be so late! That's what I get for keeping up with the news.

Text:
神羅は社長交代だって
景気よくなるといいねえ

English.Text: Shinra's getting a new president, huh? Hope he does something for the economy.

Text: カームに避難してきたのか？

English.Text: Came here to escape the chaos?

Text:
ウータイとこのまま戦争突入なんて
勘弁してくれよ

English.Text: Please tell me this won't rekindle the war with Wutai. That's the last thing we need.

Text: アバランチ　早く捕まるといいよな

English.Text: I hope they catch those Avalanche guys soon.

Text:
ミッドガルが封鎖されてるって
ほんと？

English.Text: Did they really lock down the whole city?

Text: 今日は多めに買い物　買い物っと

English.Text: Might be time to start hoarding supplies.

Text:
アバランチ？
ネズミ被害のほうが困るのよ

English.Text: Avalanche? I'm worried about the poor rats caught in the cross fire.

Text: ミッドガル　いま大変なの？

English.Text: Hey, do you know what's going on in Midgar?

Text:
聞いてよ　もう
洗濯機が動いてなかったのよ

English.Text: My washing machine crapped out on me again. Can you believe it?

Text: 竜巻の影響かしら　天気が不安定よね

English.Text: I wonder if this crazy weather had anything to do with that tornado.

Text: そろそろ買い替え時かねえ

English.Text: Guess it's time I bought a new one.

Text:
そりゃ　ミッドガルからの
魔晄が減ってるからよ

English.Text: It's not your machine; it's the mako pipeline!

Text:
アバランチの連中が
魔晄炉を爆破したから

English.Text: The town's been runnin' on fumes since those terrorist attacks.

Text:
えっ　うちの洗濯物が汚れたままなのは
そのアバランチってやつらのせいなの？

English.Text: So it's Avalanche's fault I have to keep wearing dirty underwear? Those absolute monsters!

Text:
どっちにせよ
旦那に新しいのを買わせるチャンスよ

English.Text: Either way... It's a good excuse to get your husband to buy you a new one!

Text:
いまでは　なんでもかんでも
魔晄エネルギーで動く

English.Text: Technology sure has come a long way since our younger days.

Text: 便利な世の中になったものだ

English.Text: Hard to think we got by without mako.

Text:
神羅が魔晄を送ってくれるからですねえ
感謝しないと

English.Text: Honestly, I don't know where we'd be without Shinra. Life is so much better now.

Text:
田舎だと思ってたけど　いいなあカーム
もうここに住んじまおうかな

English.Text: You know, I thought Kalm was some hick town in the middle of nowhere. Surprised it's actually kinda liveable.

Text:
でさ　ここにも
蜜蜂の館とか　ある？

English.Text: So...you guys got anything here like the Honeybee Inn?

Text: ねえよ　酒場で我慢しとけって

English.Text: Why don't you just stick to regular bars for now?

Text:
踊り子に貢ぎまくって
借金取りに追われてるの知ってるんだぞ

English.Text: The Honeybee Inn is the whole reason you're out here, man. You wanna rack up more debt?

Text:
スキルブックってのは
俺には無理だよな

English.Text: Those folios are too much for me. Can't understand them at all.

Text:
ああ～……
『サボテン大王』は売り切れか

English.Text: Ahhh... Cactuar King's completely sold out? Lame.

Text:
ここは　魔導書店マグナタの
１号店なんだよ

English.Text: This is where it all began─the first Maghnata Books.

Text:
店長さんの衣装は
星命学の学者風らしいわ

English.Text: Judging from that outfit, the manager's really into planetology.

Text:
ここは　全国展開されています
魔導書店『マグナタ』の１号店です

English.Text: Here we have the very first Maghnata Books, which has since grown into a worldwide chain.

Text:
コスモキャニオン発祥の
星命学を起源とする

English.Text: It is their mission to spread knowledge of planetology...

Text:
難解なスキルブックの知見を
民衆に広めようと努力を続けている
歴史ある本屋さんです

English.Text: through the distribution of their trademark folios, in the hopes of creating a brighter future for people everywhere.

Text:
初代の店長さんは引退され　現在は
お弟子さんが経営を引き継いでいます

English.Text: The original manager of this historic location has since retired, leaving it in the care of one of his pupils.

Text:
こちらは
武器屋『セルヴァカーサ』です

English.Text: And here we have the weapon shop, Selvacarsa.

Text:
グラスランドのモンスターに
負けないように　カームの熟練の職人が
鍛錬した武器がそろっています

English.Text: Our blacksmiths work endlessly to supply the people of Kalm with arms to defend themselves and their homes.

Text:
お土産にひとつ
護身用に　もうひとつ

English.Text: Why not browse their wares─maybe take home a souvenir?

Text: お買い上げになってはいかがでしょうか

English.Text: The craftsmanship is second to none!

Text:
こちらは　グラスランドの眺望を
一望できる　見晴らし塔です

English.Text: Kalm's iconic clock tower provides a commanding view of the surrounding grasslands.

Text:
塔の上で告白したカップルは
結ばれるという伝承もあり

English.Text: Local legend claims that a proposal made at the top is sure to be accepted...

Text:
恋人たちに人気の
デートスポットとなっています

English.Text: so─naturally─it's become one of the most popular date spots.

Text:
永遠の幸せを願いながら
広大な世界の風を　感じてみてください

English.Text: After all, what could be more romantic than standing atop the world and professing your undying love?

Text:
このあたりは
カームのご家庭の食卓を彩る市場です

English.Text: And here's the market that furnishes our dinner tables with the freshest produce.

Text:
朝は　採れたての野菜が並ぶ
朝市が開催されています

English.Text: It opens early in the morning with the very first shipment of local vegetables.

Text:
お昼は　素朴な味のランチを楽しむ
お客様でにぎわい

English.Text: Visit in the afternoon to be treated to some of the best lunches in Kalm...

Text:
夕方には　家族の晩ごはんを
作る人たちが　多く訪れます

English.Text: then swing by in the evening to spend time with the locals picking up ingredients for supper.

Text:
ミッドガルやジュノンとはひと味違う
栄養満点の　新鮮な食材で作られる

English.Text: Finally, finish off your day with a hearty Kalm meal that'll leave you raring for a new day of sightseeing.

Text:
故郷の料理を味わってみては
いかがでしょうか

English.Text: You won't find anything like it in Midgar or Junon!

Text:
この魔晄タンクは　カームの
日々の生活を支えています

English.Text: This mako tank allows us to live in comfort, with every modern convenience.

Text:
魔晄エネルギーは　地面の下や
地上を通る大きなパイプを通じて
ミッドガルから供給されています

English.Text: Our supply of mako comes to us all the way from the great city of Midgar, through a giant pipe that travels both above- and belowground.

Text:
共和国時代の給水塔を
モチーフにした形状となっており

English.Text: The tank itself is modeled after Kalm's old republic-era water tower...

Text:
カームを象徴する
モニュメントのひとつです

English.Text: and is one of our town's most famous landmarks.

Text:
チョコボみたいに可愛い恋人が
できたんだって？

English.Text: Landed yourself a cutie, huh? Congrats.

Text: 俺にも紹介してくれよ

English.Text: You gotta introduce me.

Text: チョコボみたいじゃなくて

English.Text: I wouldn't call 'im a "cutie."

Text:
カームファングみたいな
かっこいい彼氏だよ

English.Text: He's more dashing. Like a wolf.

Text:
ああ　彼氏？
なんだ　そうだったのか
おめでとう

English.Text: Oh. Hey, that's great, man. I'm glad you found the one for you. Seriously, congratulations.

Text:
最近　カームコケシ作り始めたから
いい感じに稼げてるんだ

English.Text: Damn... Who knew there was so much gil to be made in this wooden doll business?

Text:
おお　コケシ！
うちのかみさんも買ってたな
可愛いってよ

English.Text: Get out─you make those? My wife picked one up recently. Said it's the cutest!

Text:
あれが可愛いのか……
夢で　あれに追いかけられて怖いんだ

English.Text: "Cute," huh? I'd say they look like the stuff of nightmares, but to each their own.

Text:
また面接落ちたよ
２７回目　もう嫌になるよ

English.Text: That's the twenty-seventh time I've bombed the interview... I'm never gonna get the job at this rate!

Text: いったい　なにが悪いんだよ

English.Text: I just wish I knew what I was doing wrong.

Text:
こっちで林業継げば　安定してるし
あんなにかわいい嫁もいるのに

English.Text: Why are you so hung up on getting a job in Midgar? Just take over your family's business.

Text:
どうして　ミッドガルの仕事に
こだわるのよ

English.Text: Besides, you've already built up a life here.

Text:
オレは蜜蜂になりたいんだ
キレイな　蜜蜂になりたいんだよ！

English.Text: No! I've dreamt of being a honeyboy my entire life, and I'm not gonna give up now!

Text:
ぼく　大きくなったら
神羅のソルジャーになるんだ

English.Text: When I grow up, I'm gonna be a SOLDIER and fight bad guys!

Text:
そのために　いまから
モウクンレンしてるんだ！

English.Text: So I gotta start training hard now or I'll never make it!

Text:
お兄ちゃん　子供っぽくて
わたし　恥ずかしい

English.Text: Ugh, I hate when he talks like that. It's so embarrassing.

Text:
きれいな空気　どこまでも広い空
プレートがないだけで　この解放感！

English.Text: Breathe in that fresh air! Take in the never-ending sky! Goodbye Midgar, hello freedom.

Text:
ここなら彼氏とケンカ別れしたこと
忘れられそうね

English.Text: This is just what I needed to put that creep behind me.

Text: そうそう　アイツ

English.Text: Ugh, that absolute pig...

Text:
まさか私も振るなんてありえないわ
ホント

English.Text: I can't believe he dumped both of us! The nerve!

Text:
えっ　あんたもアイツと付き合ってたの
そんな話　聞いたことないんですけど！

English.Text: Wait, you were dating him too? How am I only finding out about this now!? What the hell!?

Text: しまった　これ秘密だったわ

English.Text: Oh crap. I wasn't supposed to tell you that part.

Text:
このまえ　道に迷って
物見やぐらまで行ったら

English.Text: Took a wrong turn the other day and wound up at the lookout on the cliff.

Text:
盗賊団みたいなのに追いかけられて
大変だったよ

English.Text: It was crawling with bandits. Do not recommend.

Text: 相変わらず方向音痴ね

English.Text: You gotta pay more attention to where you're going.

Text:
このまえも農場に行こうとして
船着き場に行っちゃって
モンスターに追いかけられてたじゃない

English.Text: I'll never forget the time you set off for the farms and somehow wound up at the swamp, surrounded by monsters.

Text:
ああ　空の鳥を眺めながら歩いてると
変なとこいっちゃうんだよなあ

English.Text: Yeah, you think I would've learned by now that staring up at the sky as I walk is a recipe for disaster.

Text:
『我はカイルゲイト伯爵！
　見よ　この凛々しくそそり立つ壁を』

English.Text: "I am Baron Kylegate! Behold the towering wall that I have built!"

Text: 『ああ　カームの未来は幸いなり！』

English.Text: "The future of Kalm is bright indeed!"

Text: いや　こうじゃないな

English.Text: No, no! That won't do at all.

Text:
カーム歌劇団のために
もっと　いい話を書かないとな

English.Text: We'll never draw crowds to the theater with hackneyed drivel like this.

Text:
おはよう　みんな集まったら
今日はなにする？

English.Text: Morning! Whaddaya wanna do today once everyone gets here?

Text:
昨日『追いかけラット』やったから
今日は『くすぐりオーガ』やるって
決めたじゃん

English.Text: We're gonna play Hide-and-Tickle today 'cause we played Rat Race yesterday. Right?

Text:
そうそう！
集まったらオーガ決めないとね

English.Text: We are, don't worry! We'll decide who's "it" when the others come.

Text:
週末にミッドガルでイベントだったのに
封鎖なんて

English.Text: I was really looking forward to going into Midgar this weekend...

Text:
マテリアイスの大食い大会
今度こそ　全制覇狙ってたの

English.Text: That materia pop eating contest was my chance to try the flavors I haven't yet.

Text:
来週なら限定タイタンアイスが出るから
それまで待つと思えばいいんじゃない？

English.Text: What about next week? They're bringing back that limited edition Titan pop. You liked that one, didn't you?

Text:
あれ　大きすぎてお腹いっぱいになるの
マテリアイス全制覇できなくなるのよね

English.Text: Thing is, I gotta finish it, but that one's so big that by the time I have, I'll be way too full to try any of the other types.

Text:
そういえばさ　モーグリ書店が出してる
『サボテン大王』の新作読んだ？

English.Text: Oh my god, tell me you've read the latest issue of Cactuar King. It's legit amazing!

Text: うそ　『サボ大』の新作出てたの？

English.Text: What!? No one told me that was out already!

Text:
えっえっ　じゃあ
サボーン七世はどうなったの？

English.Text: Oh, man... I've gotta know what happens to Cacter the Seventh!

Text:
貸したげるからあんたも読んで
あっ　みんなにネタバレ厳禁だからね！

English.Text: No worries, I'll lend you my copy. Oh, but don't spoil anything for other people, 'kay?

Text: 息子がミッドガルで働いてる

English.Text: My boy and I had a big falling-out.

Text:
ケンカ別れしちまったが
プロの歌手になって成功したって聞いた

English.Text: He moved to Midgar because of it. Word is he's a well-known singer now...

Text:
やっと『月刊ミステリック』
買えたんだ～！

English.Text: I finally got my hands on the new issue of Mysteryc!

Text: ほら　見てよ

English.Text: Pretty cool, isn't it?

Text:
共和国時代の戦車や風車が
きれいに載ってる！

English.Text: It's got pics of republic tanks, and windmills, and─everything!

Text: 遺跡の写真集なんて見て楽しいか？

English.Text: You like lookin' at rusted hunks of crap?

Text:
『週刊チョコボーイ』じゃ
チョコボグラビアなんてのもあるんだぞ

English.Text: Chocoboy Weekly is way better. Check out these sweet birds!

Text: いいんです～

English.Text: Yeah, no thanks.

Text:
可愛いものより　古いもの
歴史が感じられるものがいいのよ

English.Text: I'll take historic, educational artifacts over cheap cutesy crap every time.

Text:
はあ　いつかコスモキャニオンに
旅行にいきたいわ～

English.Text: One of these days I gotta make it out to Cosmo Canyon...

Text:
居眠りするヒマもない
労働の日々だ

English.Text: Barely had time to squeeze in a nap, we were so busy.

Text:
まあ　きみが毎月稼ぐ金を
１日で稼いでいたぞ

English.Text: Though it paid well enough. One day's earnings were about what an average man makes in a month.

Text:
うひょ　うらやましいだろ
名刺いるか　うん？

English.Text: Well? Jealous? I'll bet you want my business card now, don't you?

Text: 景気はどうですかな

English.Text: So, what's new with you?

Text:
私のほうは　息子に譲った
コスタに出してるホテルが順調でして

English.Text: As for me, the hotel I left my son in Costa del Sol seems to be doing well.

Text: おお　いいですな

English.Text: Well, that's excellent news!

Text:
私はチョコボレースに投資しようかと
計画中です

English.Text: Personally, I'm thinking of investing in a chocobo racing team.

Text:
ほう　チョコボ遊びなら
ファームまるごと買っちゃうほうが
安いかもしれませんな

English.Text: If it's chocobos you're interested in, you'd be better off buying a ranch of your own. That's where the real money's at.

Text:
地元のチェリーと
チョコレートを使ったお菓子よ

English.Text: Our candy uses locally produced cherries and chocolate!

Text: どうぞ　試食していって！

English.Text: Free samples available!

Text: ミッドガルアレンジもあるわよ
